This approach thus allows a deeper understanding of the main mechanisms affecting the non-equilibrium electric-field distribution in CdTe Schottky detectors, such as those leading to polarization. In the future, it could also be used to predict and improve the performance of planar or electrode-segmented detectors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用Pockels效应探测”、“电光成像装置”、“提取电场矢量图”等实验手段，并结合数值模拟进行验证。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是肖特基型CdTe辐射探测器，物理现象是入射辐射（光学光束）对探测器内部电场分布的局部扰动，以及由此导致的空间电荷积累和极化效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过电光成像技术成功绘制了CdTe探测器在光学扰动下的二维电场矢量图及其动态演化，并验证了一个基于单一深能级的两能级模型，该模型能够完全解释扰动电场的时空动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过电光成像技术成功绘制了CdTe探测器在光学扰动下的二维电场矢量图及其动态演化，并验证了一个基于单一深能级的两能级模型，该模型能够完全解释扰动电场的时空动力学。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用Pockels效应进行电光成像，结合自定义处理程序提取二维电场矢量图；理论上通过数值模拟验证了一个基于主导深能级的两能级模型。

papers.title: Temporal glide symmetry enforces a parity sideband selection rule in scalar bulk media
papers.abstract: Symmetry is a powerful way to control coupling between photonic mode families. In spatially periodic structures, glide symmetry can protect band contacts and suppress stop bands. Here we show a different role for temporal glide, a spatiotemporal counterpart combining reflection with a half-period time translation. In a scalar time-modulated trilayer waveguide, temporal glide imposes an exact selection rule linking frequency conversion to transverse-mode symmetry: the parity content of every Floquet eigenstate alternates with sideband index, up to a state-dependent sign. In scattering, this means that a mode of definite parity can emit only into the opposite transverse parity at odd sidebands and into the same parity at even sidebands. We verify the rule directly in bulk Floquet eigenstates and in finite-section time-domain simulations. An incident odd waveguide mode is converted into an even frequency sideband, while all symmetry-forbidden output channels at the analysed sidebands are suppressed to numerically negligible values. Rather than acting as a temporal copy of spatial-glide band sticking, temporal glide provides a distinct symmetry principle for converting electromagnetic energy between selected modes and frequencies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：symmetry analysis、Floquet eigenstates、time-domain simulations）；研究对象：时间调制的三层波导（scalar time-modulated trilayer waveguide）中的光频转换与横向模式对称性耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 时间滑移对称性（temporal glide symmetry）在标量体介质中强制施加了一个宇称边带选择规则：每个Floquet本征态的宇称随边带索引交替变化，导致入射模式在奇数边带只能转换为相反横向宇称的模式，在偶数边带只能转换为相同宇称的模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：时间滑移对称性（temporal glide symmetry）在标量体介质中强制施加了一个宇称边带选择规则：每个Floquet本征态的宇称随边带索引交替变化，导致入射模式在奇数边带只能转换为相反横向宇称的模式，在偶数边带只能转换为相同宇称的模式。；创新点：揭示了时间滑移对称性（空间滑移对称性的时空对应物）在频率转换中扮演的独特角色——它不是空间滑移能带粘附的简单时间副本，而是提供了一种在选定模式与频率之间转换电磁能量的全新对称性原理。
papers.method_zh: 对称性分析（基于时间滑移对称性）、Floquet本征态计算、有限截面时域仿真（finite-section time-domain simulations）。

papers.title: Diffusive Dynamics of Nonstabilizerness
papers.abstract: Symmetries shape the quantum-information dynamics of many-body systems, but their effect on nonstabilizerness, the resource complementary to entanglement, is less understood. We compute the stabilizer Rényi entropy, a measure of nonstabilizerness, in $\mathrm{U}(1)$-symmetric one-dimensional random circuits. The disorder-averaged dynamics is captured by a four-replica tensor network, which we evaluate by $S_4$-adapted infinite time-evolving block decimation (iTEBD) directly in the thermodynamic limit. Together with a hydrodynamic argument, our results identify a diffusive universality class for the late-time approach of nonstabilizerness to its random-state value, with the stabilizer Rényi entropy gap closing as $1/t$. The same scaling is verified in an energy-conserving nonintegrable Ising chain. More broadly, our framework provides a hydrodynamic perspective on nonstabilizerness generation and offers insight into the design of approximate Haar-random states in Hamiltonian dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：计算、tensor network、iTEBD、hydrodynamic argument。；研究对象：U(1)对称一维随机电路中的非稳定化子（nonstabilizerness）的扩散动力学，以及能量守恒非可积伊辛链中的非稳定化子行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非稳定化子在晚期趋近随机态值的过程中属于扩散普适类，其稳定化子Rényi熵的间隙按1/t的标度律闭合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非稳定化子在晚期趋近随机态值的过程中属于扩散普适类，其稳定化子Rényi熵的间隙按1/t的标度律闭合。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过四副本张量网络描述无序平均动力学，采用S4适应的无限时间演化块消去（iTEBD）直接在热力学极限下计算；结合流体力学论证分析晚期行为；并在能量守恒的非可积伊辛链中验证标度律。

papers.title: A ribbon ZX calculus for gauge theory
papers.abstract: ZX calculus provides a graphical formalism for reasoning about quantum processes, built from two interacting Frobenius algebras associated with the Z and X bases of a qubit. While it has found widespread application in quantum information and computing, its relationship to quantum field theory has only recently begun to be explored. In this work, we further develop this connection by providing a generalization of ZX calculus to two-dimensional Yang Mills theory with a compact gauge group. The key observation is that both frameworks can be organized around the Hopf Frobenius algebraic structure associated with a group algebra, which can in turn be described by the diagrammatics of two dimensional topological quantum field theory. Given the well known relationship between gauge theory and gravity in two and three dimensions, our work paves the way for applications of ZX to low dimensional gravity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：ZX calculus、graphical formalism、generalization、Yang Mills theory、topological quantum field theory。；研究对象：二维杨-米尔斯理论（two-dimensional Yang Mills theory），涉及紧致规范群（compact gauge group），并关联到低维引力理论。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: ZX calculus可推广至具有紧致规范群的二维杨-米尔斯理论，其核心在于群代数上的Hopf Frobenius代数结构可由二维拓扑量子场论的图解法描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：ZX calculus可推广至具有紧致规范群的二维杨-米尔斯理论，其核心在于群代数上的Hopf Frobenius代数结构可由二维拓扑量子场论的图解法描述。；创新点：首次将ZX calculus与二维杨-米尔斯理论建立系统联系，并指出该工作为ZX calculus应用于低维引力理论铺平道路。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于ZX calculus的图形化形式体系，利用群代数上的Hopf Frobenius代数结构，结合二维拓扑量子场论的图解方法进行理论推广。

papers.title: A refined thermodynamic analysis of nonsecular master equations
papers.abstract: We present a systematic thermodynamic analysis of nonsecular master equations. We consider master equations resulting either from the partial secular and the geometric-arithmetic approximations, two approximations ensuring the positivity of the system's dynamics when some of its transition frequencies are too small to enable the full secular approximation. Both cause the system to relax towards a steady state which is not the Gibbs state of its bare Hamiltonian. Nonetheless, we build a unified, consistent thermodynamic framework for those dynamics. Starting from a microscopic expression of the second law based on system-environment correlations, we employ a systematic perturbation theory to preserve the positivity of the second law despite the approximations done on the dynamics. We show that, in spite of the weak system-bath coupling, the system-bath interaction energy participates to the energy balance, as well as the Lamb-shift. Those extra contributions give rise to work performed by the system on the bath when the former is out of equilibrium. We compare this microscopic entropy production with the definition based on the contractivity of the reduced system dynamics (Spohn inequality). We show that, unlike for secular master equations, the two entropy production rates differ because of the presence of non-vanishing stationary coherences in the energy eigenbasis. However, in the case of a single thermal bath, the difference is purely transient, and no work can be cyclically extracted from the steady-state despite its non-Gibbs form. Finally, we illustrate our results with a simple example, clarifying and completing the thermodynamic picture of Markovian dynamics in the quantum regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：thermodynamic analysis、master equations、perturbation theory、microscopic expression。；研究对象：非世俗主方程（nonsecular master equations）描述的开量子系统热力学，具体涉及部分世俗近似和几何-算术近似下系统与热库耦合的动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非世俗主方程框架下，系统稳态并非其裸哈密顿量的吉布斯态，但可建立统一且自洽的热力学框架；系统-库相互作用能和兰姆移位参与能量平衡，导致非平衡时系统对库做功；与世俗主方程不同，两种熵产生率因稳态能量本征基下非零相干性而不同，但在单一热库情形下差异仅为瞬态，无法从非吉布斯稳态循环提取功。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非世俗主方程框架下，系统稳态并非其裸哈密顿量的吉布斯态，但可建立统一且自洽的热力学框架；系统-库相互作用能和兰姆移位参与能量平衡，导致非平衡时系统对库做功；与世俗主方程不同，两种熵产生率因稳态能量本征基下非零相干性而不同，但在单一热库情形下差异仅为瞬态，无法从非吉布斯稳态循环提取功。；创新点：首次对非世俗主方程（包括部分世俗近似和几何-算术近似）给出统一、一致的热力学分析，揭示了稳态相干性对熵产生率差异的贡献，并澄清了非吉布斯稳态下功提取的局限性。
papers.method_zh: 基于系统-环境关联的微观第二定律表达式，采用系统微扰理论保持第二定律的正定性；对比基于约化动力学收缩性（Spohn不等式）的熵产生定义；通过简单示例进行验证。

papers.title: Optical Implementation of Equilibrium Propagation Using Spatial Photonic Ising Machines
papers.abstract: Equilibrium Propagation offers a compelling alternative to traditional machine learning for training energy-based networks. Here we demonstrate a hybrid optical-digital implementation of EP using a Spatial Photonic Ising Machine (SPIM). The SPIM exploits the gauge transformation method to optically encode both continuous neuron states and rank-1 binary trainable patterns as phase modulations via a spatial light modulator, with inference realized using a finite difference scheme. The experimental system is evaluated on the Wine classification dataset. The potential of this approach, including the use of continuous couplings and structured coupling matrices, is evaluated numerically on the more complex MNIST dataset. Our work provides a concrete pathway toward energy-efficient physical implementations of Equilibrium Propagation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+数值计算）。关键词：hybrid optical-digital implementation、experimental system is evaluated、evaluated numerically。；研究对象：基于空间光子伊辛机（Spatial Photonic Ising Machine, SPIM）的光学-数字混合系统，用于实现平衡传播（Equilibrium Propagation）算法，训练基于能量的神经网络。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用空间光子伊辛机成功实现了平衡传播算法的光学-数字混合实验，在Wine分类数据集上进行了实验验证，并在MNIST数据集上通过数值模拟展示了连续耦合与结构化耦合矩阵的潜力，为低能耗物理实现平衡传播提供了具体路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用空间光子伊辛机成功实现了平衡传播算法的光学-数字混合实验，在Wine分类数据集上进行了实验验证，并在MNIST数据集上通过数值模拟展示了连续耦合与结构化耦合矩阵的潜力，为低能耗物理实现平衡传播提供了具体路径。；创新点：首次将平衡传播算法在空间光子伊辛机上进行光学-数字混合实验实现，利用光学手段编码神经元状态和可训练模式，替代传统纯电子计算方式，为低能耗物理实现提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用空间光调制器（SLM）通过规范变换方法（gauge transformation method）光学编码连续神经元状态和秩1二值可训练模式（rank-1 binary trainable patterns）作为相位调制，推理过程使用有限差分方案（finite difference scheme）实现。数值上对更复杂的MNIST数据集进行了连续耦合与结构化耦合矩阵的评估。

papers.title: Momentum Space Algorithm for Electronic Structure of Double-Incommensurate Trilayer Graphene
papers.abstract: Numerical algorithms for computing electronic structure of incommensurate 2D materials using ab initio models is critical for predicting material properties and guiding experiment. For bilayers, momentum space and continuum models have been introduced to approximate observables of ab initio tight-binding models using a momenta description despite the lack of periodicity in the tight-binding model required for Bloch theory. A similar structure has been introduced for double-incommensurate trilayers using a continuum model, where the three lattices are all mutually incommensurate. However, this description leads to a four-dimensional lattice space, and numerical convergence of the density of states was observed to have poor convergence. In this work, we introduce a momentum space framework for double incommensurate trilayer graphene, and introduce an efficient truncation scheme of the four-dimensional lattice to drastically improve convergence of the density of states and momentum local density of states (a parallel object to classical band structure). We implement this algorithm on an ab initio model of twisted trilayer graphene and validate convergence estimates. We further verify numerically that the momentum space algorithm, inherently higher order than the continuum model as it is an exact transformation of the tight-binding model, captures altered band behavior near the flat bands at magic angles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：numerical algorithms、momentum space framework、ab initio model、tight-binding model。；研究对象：双非公度三层石墨烯（double-incommensurate trilayer graphene）的电子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种动量空间算法，通过高效的截断方案显著改善了双非公度三层石墨烯态密度和动量局域态密度的数值收敛性，并验证了该算法能捕捉魔角附近平带的能带行为变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种动量空间算法，通过高效的截断方案显著改善了双非公度三层石墨烯态密度和动量局域态密度的数值收敛性，并验证了该算法能捕捉魔角附近平带的能带行为变化。；创新点：该动量空间算法是紧束缚模型的精确变换，本质上比连续模型（continuum model）具有更高阶的精度，并解决了此前连续模型在四维晶格空间中数值收敛性差的问题。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理紧束缚模型（ab initio tight-binding model），构建了四维晶格空间的动量空间框架，并引入高效的截断方案（truncation scheme）以加速态密度和动量局域态密度的收敛。算法在扭曲三层石墨烯（twisted trilayer graphene）模型上实现并验证了收敛性估计。

papers.title: Numerical Hints for Dyon Condensation at $θ=2π$ via Wilson-'t Hooft Loops in $SU(2)$ Yang-Mills Theory
papers.abstract: Yang-Mills theories at $θ$ and $θ+2π$ are unitarily equivalent, but their $2π$ periodicity has a nontrivial realization. Recent developments in generalized global symmetries show that confinement vacua at $θ=0$ and $2π$ should belong to different symmetry-protected topological (SPT) states with the $1$-form center symmetry. For its examination, we measure the Wilson-'t Hooft loop operators at $θ=2π$ for the $SU(2)$ Wilson lattice gauge action and discuss their long-distance behaviors. This requires us to identify the gauge topological charge in the presence of defects, and we employ the $1$-form covariant DBW2 gradient flow to smear lattice gauge fields. We then obtain numerical evidence consistent with dyon condensation at $θ=2π$, rather than monopole condensation, as theoretically predicted.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：数值证据、测量、格子规范理论、梯度流）；研究对象：SU(2) 杨-米尔斯理论在θ=2π处的真空性质，特别是dyon凝聚与monopole凝聚的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过测量Wilson-’t Hooft环算符的长程行为，获得了与dyon凝聚（而非monopole凝聚）一致的数值证据，支持了θ=0和θ=2π的禁闭真空属于不同对称性保护拓扑（SPT）态的理论预言。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过测量Wilson-’t Hooft环算符的长程行为，获得了与dyon凝聚（而非monopole凝聚）一致的数值证据，支持了θ=0和θ=2π的禁闭真空属于不同对称性保护拓扑（SPT）态的理论预言。；创新点：首次通过数值方法直接检验了θ=2π处dyon凝聚与monopole凝聚的区分，为广义全局对称性框架下关于SPT态的理论预测提供了数值支持。
papers.method_zh: 采用SU(2) Wilson格子规范作用量，在θ=2π处测量Wilson-’t Hooft环算符；使用1-形式协变DBW2梯度流对格子规范场进行涂抹，以在存在缺陷的情况下识别规范拓扑荷。

papers.title: Steady-State Noise Signatures of Lindbladian Exceptional Points
papers.abstract: Exceptional points (EPs) are non-Hermitian degeneracies at which two or more eigenvalues and their corresponding eigenvectors coalesce. In open quantum systems, exceptional points can arise in the Lindbladian governing the dissipative dynamics. Their signatures have so far been mainly identified in finite-time observables, such as transient currents, while steady-state average currents generally provide no direct evidence of the underlying exceptional-point structure. In this work, we demonstrate that signatures of Lindbladian EPs can nevertheless be accessed in the steady-state regime through current noise. We derive general expressions for current correlation functions within a Lindblad master-equation framework and show, in particular, how exceptional points affect their behaviour as a function of the time delay. We illustrate these results with the paradigmatic example of two interacting qubits coupled to two reservoirs, where the steady-state noise clearly distinguishes overdamped, underdamped, and critical regimes. Our results establish current correlation functions as a steady-state probe of Lindbladian EPs in open quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Lindblad主方程框架、推导一般表达式、理论分析。；研究对象：开放量子系统中Lindbladian奇异点（非厄米简并点）的稳态噪声特征，具体以两个相互作用的量子比特耦合到两个热库的模型为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了Lindbladian奇异点可以通过稳态电流噪声（而非平均电流）来探测，噪声随延迟时间的行为能清晰区分过阻尼、欠阻尼和临界三种动力学区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了Lindbladian奇异点可以通过稳态电流噪声（而非平均电流）来探测，噪声随延迟时间的行为能清晰区分过阻尼、欠阻尼和临界三种动力学区域。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于Lindblad主方程框架，推导了电流关联函数的一般表达式，并通过两个相互作用量子比特耦合到两个热库的范例模型进行数值验证。

papers.title: Interference of critical dynamics associated with zero modes
papers.abstract: We study the interference of critical dynamics associated with zero modes (ICDZM) in the generalized Creutz ladders using closed quench paths that pass through two critical points successively. By reading out the final zero-mode transfer probability, we find rich ICDZM interference patterns dependent on the quench path. In particular, when the closed path links two topologically nontrivial phases, the ICDZM pattern may either vanish or exhibit period doubling. Within the framework of WKB analysis, this phenomenon is well clarified by the interference phase accumulated in the quench procedure. We also demonstrate that the zero-mode transfer probability can be detected by the deviation of the boundary particle number from its initial fractional value, which arises from the blending of bulk modes in the critical dynamics. As an edge defect, the zero-mode transfer probability captures both the ICDZM oscillation and the known anomalous defect production in a non-closed quench path. These results identify ICDZM and the corresponding edge defect as probes for critical dynamics associated with topological zero modes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“研究”（study）、“WKB分析”、“理论框架”，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：广义Creutz梯子模型中的零模临界动力学干涉现象（ICDZM），具体涉及通过闭合淬火路径穿越两个临界点时的零模转移概率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当闭合淬火路径连接两个拓扑非平庸相时，ICDZM干涉图案可能消失或出现周期倍增现象；零模转移概率可通过边界粒子数相对于初始分数值的偏离来探测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当闭合淬火路径连接两个拓扑非平庸相时，ICDZM干涉图案可能消失或出现周期倍增现象；零模转移概率可通过边界粒子数相对于初始分数值的偏离来探测。；创新点：首次揭示了闭合淬火路径中零模临界动力学干涉（ICDZM）的丰富图案（如消失或周期倍增），并建立了零模转移概率与边界缺陷（边缘粒子数偏离）之间的直接联系，将其作为探测拓扑零模临界动力学的探针。
papers.method_zh: 采用闭合淬火路径（依次通过两个临界点）的动力学过程，结合WKB（Wentzel-Kramers-Brillouin）近似分析淬火过程中积累的干涉相位，并利用边界粒子数偏离探测零模转移概率。

papers.title: Chiral Long-Range Order in three Euclidean Lattice Gross-Neveu Models
papers.abstract: We prove the existence of Long-Range Order in a class of two-dimensional Euclidean lattice Gross-Neveu models with an even number of fermion flavors, covering three standard lattice discretizations, including naive and staggered fermions widely used in numerical studies. By performing a Hubbard-Stratonovich transformation, we map the fermionic systems to bosonic ones and establish Reflection Positivity for the resulting measures. Exploiting this structure, we combine Chessboard Estimates with a Peierls-type contour argument to prove Long-Range Order for the chirally charged fermion-mass bilinear $\overlineψψ$ at sufficiently small coupling and sufficiently large flavor number. Our analysis is robust with respect to the choice of lattice discretization and applies uniformly across different realizations of the same underlying continuum model. Moreover, we obtain uniform pointwise bounds on the bosonic two-point function, equivalently on the fermionic mass-mass correlator, showing that it is quantitatively controlled by the minimizers of the effective potential. This provides a fully rigorous and non-perturbative demonstration of Long-Range Order in lattice Gross-Neveu models and establishes a direct connection between the rigorous theory and its large-$N$ (mean-field) predictions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：证明、映射、严格、非微扰。；研究对象：二维欧几里得格点Gross-Neveu模型，具体涵盖三种标准格点离散化方案（包括naive费米子和staggered费米子），研究其手性长程序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在足够小的耦合常数和足够大的费米子味道数下，证明了手性荷费米子质量双线性项⟨ψ̅ψ⟩存在长程序，并获得了玻色子两点函数（等价于费米子质量-质量关联函数）的一致逐点有界性，表明其受有效势极小值的定量控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在足够小的耦合常数和足够大的费米子味道数下，证明了手性荷费米子质量双线性项⟨ψ̅ψ⟩存在长程序，并获得了玻色子两点函数（等价于费米子质量-质量关联函数）的一致逐点有界性，表明其受有效势极小值的定量控制。；创新点：首次对格点Gross-Neveu模型给出了完全严格且非微扰的长程序证明，并建立了严格理论与大N（平均场）预言之间的直接联系；该证明对不同的格点离散化方案具有鲁棒性。
papers.method_zh: 通过Hubbard-Stratonovich变换将费米子系统映射为玻色子系统，建立反射正性；结合棋盘估计与Peierls型轮廓论证，严格证明长程序的存在性。

papers.title: Fibonacci Steady-States and Persistent Oscillations in an Ordered Multimode Dicke Model
papers.abstract: Ultracold atoms in multimode optical cavities provide a rich testbed for many-body phenomena enabled by light-mediated interactions. Recent experiments include realizations of spin glasses and associative memories, as described by multimode Dicke models with disordered couplings. However, the properties of multimode Dicke models with ordered coupling geometries remain largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate the stable steady-states of the multimode Dicke model with an ordered nearest-neighbor coupling geometry, where $n_c$ atomic clusters are coupled via $n_c-1$ cavity modes. We show that the number of mean-field stable steady-states in the superradiant phase exhibits Fibonacci scaling with the number of atomic clusters, and that a subset of these steady-states exhibit persistent oscillations. Using both the truncated Wigner approximation and the numerically-exact hierarchy of pure states, we further demonstrate that these features of the stable steady-state solutions persist for finite cluster sizes. Ordered multimode Dicke models, such as the nearest-neighbor coupling geometry considered here, are accessible with current experimental technologies and point toward a broader class of strongly interacting dissipative systems with similarly rich behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：investigate、mean-field、truncated Wigner approximation、hierarchy of pure states）；研究对象：有序多模Dicke模型中的稳态与持续振荡现象，具体为具有最近邻耦合几何结构的原子团簇-腔模耦合系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超辐射相中，平均场稳态数目随原子团簇数呈斐波那契标度，且部分稳态表现出持续振荡；这些特征在有限团簇尺寸下依然存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超辐射相中，平均场稳态数目随原子团簇数呈斐波那契标度，且部分稳态表现出持续振荡；这些特征在有限团簇尺寸下依然存在。；创新点：首次系统研究了有序耦合几何（最近邻结构）的多模Dicke模型的稳态性质，揭示了斐波那契标度与持续振荡行为，而此前实验与理论主要关注无序耦合情形。
papers.method_zh: 平均场理论分析稳态数目；截断维格纳近似（truncated Wigner approximation）与数值精确的纯态层次方法（hierarchy of pure states）验证有限尺寸效应。

papers.title: Experiment-compatible measurement--feedback quantum state preparation with reinforcement learning
papers.abstract: Ground-state preparation is a critical task in quantum simulation and quantum computing, as it enables the study of correlated phases and the generation of entangled resource states. While measurement--feedback control has emerged as a promising route to state preparation, existing schemes either rely on handcrafted, task-specific policies or are designed using full quantum-state information that is unavailable in real experiments and becomes impractical for large many-body systems. Here we develop an adaptive measurement--feedback protocol based on reinforcement learning under partial observability. The controller uses only the history of experimentally accessible measurement outcomes to choose both the measurement operator and the feedback action in real time. To make training compatible with experiments, we introduce a stochastic terminal reward built from one-shot measurements of randomly sampled Hamiltonian components, avoiding unphysical full-state reconstruction while remaining an unbiased estimator of the target energy. We demonstrate the method by preparing ground states of the Bose--Hubbard model and by generating GHZ states, establishing a scalable and hardware-compatible route to quantum state preparation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“reinforcement learning”（强化学习）、“protocol”（协议）、“training”（训练），属于理论框架与算法设计，未提及实验设备或数据。；研究对象：量子多体系统的基态制备，具体以Bose–Hubbard模型和GHZ态为演示体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于部分可观测强化学习的自适应测量-反馈协议，仅利用实验可获取的测量结果历史来实时选择测量算符和反馈动作，无需全量子态信息，且通过单次测量哈密顿量分量构建无偏随机终端奖励，实现了与实验兼容的基态制备。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于部分可观测强化学习的自适应测量-反馈协议，仅利用实验可获取的测量结果历史来实时选择测量算符和反馈动作，无需全量子态信息，且通过单次测量哈密顿量分量构建无偏随机终端奖励，实现了与实验兼容的基态制备。；创新点：首次将强化学习应用于仅依赖实验可观测测量结果的测量-反馈量子态制备，并引入基于单次随机测量的无偏能量估计作为奖励，解决了传统方案依赖全量子态信息或手工设计策略的局限，使协议可扩展至大规模多体系统。
papers.method_zh: 采用部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）框架下的强化学习，控制器仅依据历史测量结果序列进行决策；训练中使用随机采样的哈密顿量分量单次测量结果构造终端奖励函数，避免全量子态重构。

papers.title: Global Control with the Tavis-Cummings Interaction
papers.abstract: We study the controllability of a system of qubits under global control, where control pulses act identically on all qubits. Specifically, we consider a collection of qubits identically coupled to a single bosonic mode, or harmonic oscillator, via the Jaynes-Cummings interaction. This collective coupling, known as the Tavis-Cummings (TC) interaction, has been realized in several quantum computing platforms, including superconducting and atomic qubit systems. Although the qubits do not interact directly with one another, they can become entangled through their common coupling to the bosonic mode. We characterize the group of unitaries that can be implemented on the joint Hilbert space of the qubits and bosonic mode using the TC interaction together with a global $z$ field $J_z$, corresponding to identical z rotations on all qubits. We show that for n>2 qubits the set of realizable unitaries is restricted by an "accidental" symmetry of the TC Hamiltonian, distinct from its "standard" U(1) and permutational symmetries. On the other hand, we find that the Hamiltonian $J_z^2$ breaks this accidental symmetry and, together with the TC interaction and $J_z$, achieves semi-universality: it allows the implementation of arbitrary unitaries that respect permutational and U(1) symmetry, up to certain constraints on the center of the group. In a companion paper, we further analyze this remarkable accidental symmetry and show that it can be understood through Schwinger's bosonic model of angular momentum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：controllability（可控性）、characterize the group of unitaries（刻画酉群）、Hamiltonian（哈密顿量）。；研究对象：量子比特系统与单个玻色子模式（谐振子）通过Tavis-Cummings（TC）相互作用耦合的体系，具体为超导量子比特或原子量子比特平台中的全局控制问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于n>2个量子比特，TC哈密顿量存在一种“偶然对称性”（区别于标准U(1)和置换对称性），限制了可实现酉变换的集合；而引入J_z^2哈密顿量可打破该偶然对称性，结合TC相互作用和J_z实现“半普适性”：允许实现所有满足置换对称性和U(1)对称性的任意酉变换（受群中心约束）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于n>2个量子比特，TC哈密顿量存在一种“偶然对称性”（区别于标准U(1)和置换对称性），限制了可实现酉变换的集合；而引入J_z^2哈密顿量可打破该偶然对称性，结合TC相互作用和J_z实现“半普适性”：允许实现所有满足置换对称性和U(1)对称性的任意酉变换（受群中心约束）。；创新点：揭示了TC哈密顿量中除已知U(1)和置换对称性之外的“偶然对称性”，并证明该对称性对量子比特系统全局可控性的限制，以及通过J_z^2打破该对称性实现半普适控制的方案。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过群论和哈密顿量对称性分析，刻画由TC相互作用、全局z场J_z及J_z^2生成的酉群结构，并讨论其可控性。

papers.title: Accidental Symmetry in the Tavis-Cummings Model via the Schwinger Boson Representation
papers.abstract: The Jaynes-Cummings (JC) Hamiltonian is a paradigmatic model of light-matter interaction and, more generally, qubit-boson interactions, widely used across atomic, optical, and superconducting qubit platforms. In the multi-qubit setting, where n qubits are identically coupled to a single boson mode, this interaction is known as the Tavis-Cummings (TC) Hamiltonian. The structure of the TC model is usually understood in terms of two standard symmetries: permutation invariance of the qubits and a U(1) symmetry associated with conservation of the total excitation number. Here we identify an additional, independent "accidental" symmetry of the TC Hamiltonian and construct the corresponding conserved observable. We show that, for n>2 qubits, this symmetry imposes strong constraints on the realizable unitary transformations. These constraints persist in the presence of the global $J_z$ Hamiltonian, but are removed by adding $J_z^2$, even though $J_z^2$ preserves both permutation invariance and the U(1) symmetry. Finally, we explain the origin of this previously unnoticed symmetry using Schwinger's boson representation of angular momentum. These restrictions have important implications for controllability of the TC system and for its applications to quantum computing, which are investigated further in a companion paper.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要讨论哈密顿量结构、对称性分析、可实现的幺正变换约束等理论推导，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：Tavis-Cummings（TC）模型，即多量子比特（n个）与单个玻色子模式相同耦合的量子光学系统，属于光-物质相互作用体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在n>2个量子比特的TC哈密顿量中，除了已知的置换不变性和U(1)对称性外，还存在一个额外的“偶然”对称性，该对称性对系统可实现的幺正变换施加了强约束，且该约束在加入全局J_z项后依然存在，但加入J_z²项后可被解除。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在n>2个量子比特的TC哈密顿量中，除了已知的置换不变性和U(1)对称性外，还存在一个额外的“偶然”对称性，该对称性对系统可实现的幺正变换施加了强约束，且该约束在加入全局J_z项后依然存在，但加入J_z²项后可被解除。；创新点：首次识别出TC哈密顿量中一个此前未被注意的偶然对称性，并构造了对应的守恒可观测量，阐明了其对量子计算可控性的重要限制。
papers.method_zh: 利用Schwinger玻色子表示（Schwinger boson representation）对TC模型的角动量结构进行重新表述，从而揭示并解释该偶然对称性的起源。

papers.title: Fine-tuning MLIP foundation models: strategies for accuracy and transferability
papers.abstract: Adapting machine-learned interatomic potential (MLIP) foundation models to specialised tasks through fine-tuning is an increasingly important practice, yet systematic guidance on when and how to fine-tune is currently limited. We evaluate seven fine-tuning strategies -- naive full-parameter updates, two layer-freezing variants, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), multihead replay, pseudolabelled replay, and replay combined with LoRA -- across five chemically diverse benchmarks (aqueous NaCl, ice polymorphs, S$_\mathrm{N}$2 reactions, SPICE biomolecules, and lithium electrolytes), three generations of foundation models, and training sets spanning five orders of magnitude. To support this evaluation we implement three capabilities in the MACE codebase: LoRA adapted for equivariant message-passing architectures, including both scalar and equivariant linear layers; pseudolabelled replay, which decouples the replay data source from the original pretraining corpus; and model-aware atomic reference energy (E0) reestimation for fine-tuning workflows. We find that foundation model quality, correct E0 initialisation, and well-chosen hyperparameters are prerequisites whose impact routinely exceeds that of the fine-tuning strategy itself. Once these prerequisites are met, most strategies achieve strong target-task accuracy, consistently surpassing models trained from scratch. The practical distinction depends on deployment scope: naive fine-tuning offers the best convergence for single-system applications, while multihead replay -- with either original or pseudolabelled data -- is the only approach tested that consistently preserves out-of-distribution robustness, maintaining both pretraining-distribution accuracy for broader deployment and many-body short-range repulsion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine-learned interatomic potential (MLIP) foundation models、fine-tuning strategies、MACE codebase。；研究对象：论文研究的是机器学习原子间势（MLIP）基础模型在多种化学体系上的微调策略，具体包括：水溶液NaCl、冰多晶型、S_N2反应、SPICE生物分子和锂电解质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基础模型质量、正确的原子参考能量（E0）初始化和超参数选择是微调成功的前提，其影响通常超过微调策略本身。一旦满足这些前提，大多数微调策略都能达到强目标任务精度，但只有多头部回放（multihead replay）能一致地保持分布外鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基础模型质量、正确的原子参考能量（E0）初始化和超参数选择是微调成功的前提，其影响通常超过微调策略本身。一旦满足这些前提，大多数微调策略都能达到强目标任务精度，但只有多头部回放（multihead replay）能一致地保持分布外鲁棒性。；创新点：系统性地比较了多种微调策略在化学多样性基准、三代基础模型和跨越五个数量级的训练集上的表现，并首次在MACE框架中实现了针对等变消息传递架构的LoRA适配和伪标签回放方法。
papers.method_zh: 在MACE代码库中实现了三种新能力：适用于等变消息传递架构的LoRA（包括标量和等变线性层）、伪标签回放（将回放数据源与原始预训练语料解耦）、以及模型感知的原子参考能量（E0）重估计。评估了七种微调策略：朴素全参数更新、两种冻结层变体、低秩适应（LoRA）、多头部回放、伪标签回放、以及回放结合LoRA。

papers.title: Multiple Topological Haldane Phases for Symmetry-Protected Quantum Information Processing
papers.abstract: Symmetry-protected topological phases have attracted significant interest at the fundamental level and as a potential platform for quantum information processing, owing to their protected edge states and resilience to perturbations. Applying these features for practical and efficient quantum computation is highly desirable, but remains an open challenge. Here, we demonstrate the partitioning into multiple independent Haldane phase subsystems of a single spin-1/2 ladder system and propose this as a scalable architecture for gate-based quantum computation, which takes advantage of the symmetry-protected topological order. We encode qubits in the two topological states of the $S^{z}=0$ sector of each subsystem. Finite-size effects, typically viewed as detrimental, instead provide a controllable energy splitting that enables single-qubit rotations using only local magnetic fields. An Ising-type interaction between neighboring subsystem edges generates entangling gates, enabling universal quantum computation driven by two control parameters that are easily accessible experimentally. Our results demonstrate how symmetry-protected topological phases can be directly harnessed for circuit-model quantum computation in realistic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：demonstrate、propose、encoding、enabling（无实验或计算细节描述，属于理论方案设计）。；研究对象：自旋-1/2梯子系统中的多个独立Haldane相子系统，以及基于对称保护拓扑序的量子计算架构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将单个自旋-1/2梯子系统划分为多个独立的Haldane相子系统，并利用每个子系统S^z=0扇区的两个拓扑态编码量子比特，可以实现可扩展的、基于门操作的通用量子计算，且仅需两个实验上易调控的参数即可驱动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将单个自旋-1/2梯子系统划分为多个独立的Haldane相子系统，并利用每个子系统S^z=0扇区的两个拓扑态编码量子比特，可以实现可扩展的、基于门操作的通用量子计算，且仅需两个实验上易调控的参数即可驱动。；创新点：提出将对称保护拓扑相直接用于电路模型量子计算的具体可扩展架构，并利用通常被视为不利因素的有限尺寸效应来实现可控的单量子比特操作。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与模型构建：基于对称保护拓扑相（Haldane相）的拓扑序，利用有限尺寸效应产生的可控能级分裂实现单量子比特旋转，通过相邻子系统边缘间的Ising型相互作用实现纠缠门。

papers.title: From Loss Diagnosis to Rational Design: A Unified Analytical Model for Photoelectrochemical Cells
papers.abstract: Photoelectrochemical (PEC) cells are a compelling route to solar-driven chemical energy storage and feedstock synthesis, yet their deployment is hindered by coupled losses spanning light absorption, carrier transport, interfacial charge transfer, and semiconductor-electrolyte matching. Existing models address these losses in an architecture-specific manner and fall short of quantitative experimental diagnosis or actionable design guidance. Here, we introduce a unified loss-analysis framework applicable to both built-in junction (BIJ) and semiconductor-electrolyte junction (SEJ) photoelectrodes within a consistent set of physically meaningful parameters. The framework delivers current-voltage curves and efficiency metrics under ideal and real conditions, constructing efficiency maps to delineate theoretical limits and material-selection windows. Critically, by fitting experimental current-voltage data, it enables quantitative energy-loss decomposition into thermodynamic, optical, recombination, and interfacial contributions, pinpointing performance bottlenecks in real devices and mapping them directly onto optimization strategies such as co-catalyst integration or nanostructuring. Energy flows are visualized through Sankey diagrams, providing an intuitive picture of how incident solar energy is absorbed, dissipated, or converted into chemical output. Validated against state-of-the-art literature results spanning solar water splitting, CO2 reduction, NH3 synthesis, and solar redox flow batteries, the framework further enables systematic comparison of photovoltaic-grade absorbers (e.g., Si, perovskites) with intermediate-bandgap semiconductors (e.g., hematite, BiVO4), identifying key factors limiting each material class. Together, these capabilities support a paradigm shift from empirical optimization to mechanism-informed rational design of high-efficiency PEC energy-conversion systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：unified loss-analysis framework、efficiency maps、energy-loss decomposition、Sankey diagrams。；研究对象：光电化学（PEC）电池，涵盖内置结（BIJ）和半导体-电解液结（SEJ）两种光电极构型，以及多种材料体系（如Si、钙钛矿、赤铁矿、BiVO₄）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一个统一的损耗分析框架，能够将实验电流-电压数据定量分解为热力学、光学、复合和界面贡献，从而将性能瓶颈直接映射到优化策略（如助催化剂集成或纳米结构设计），实现从经验优化到机制指导的理性设计转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一个统一的损耗分析框架，能够将实验电流-电压数据定量分解为热力学、光学、复合和界面贡献，从而将性能瓶颈直接映射到优化策略（如助催化剂集成或纳米结构设计），实现从经验优化到机制指导的理性设计转变。；创新点：该框架统一了此前针对不同构型（BIJ与SEJ）的分散模型，首次在一致参数体系下实现定量实验诊断与可操作的设计指导，并支持不同带隙半导体材料类别的系统比较。
papers.method_zh: 基于一组物理意义一致的参数，构建理想和实际条件下的电流-电压曲线与效率图，通过拟合实验数据实现能量损耗的定量分解，并利用桑基图可视化能量流。框架验证基于文献中太阳能水分解、CO₂还原、NH₃合成和太阳能氧化还原液流电池的实验结果。

papers.title: Dynamical large deviations and long-range correlations for local weak wave turbulence
papers.abstract: Wave turbulence describes the statistical dynamics of dispersive waves with weakly nonlinear interactions. While the classical kinetic equation captures the mean evolution of the wave spectrum, the study of its fluctuations due to finite-size effects and intermittency requires a probabilistic framework for space-time trajectories of the spectrum dynamics. Following the previous large deviation theories for wave turbulence, we develop a simplification meant for qualitative and numerical predictions of measurable quantities. We derive a new large deviation principle in the case of local wave interactions. It fully characterizes typical and rare fluctuations of the spectrum. In a joint article, we obtain a theory which is a generalised form of Macroscopic Fluctuation Theory, but with 2 conserved quantities (mass and energy). In this paper, we use it to analyse the structure of the equation for Gaussian fluctuations around out-of-equilibrium spectra. In addition to the usual equilibrium contribution, we obtain long-range correlations, which can be decomposed into 3 contributions: one is driven by the flux in the bulk and another is driven by the forcing and its possible fluctuations. In addition, these contributions are computed for the first time with a method adapted to boundary conditions where only the fluxes are fixed. The results provide a general, replicable method for analyzing wave turbulence in more complex settings. Finally, the generalization of this theory to the inhomogeneous wave turbulence provides a possible explanation to the instability of the Kolmogorov-Zakharov spectra in some 1D inhomogeneous models with 4-wave interactions such as the Majda-McLaughlin-Tabak. This work opens the discussion regarding universal and non universal properties in two-point correlation functions. This opens new range of study on the phenomena of intermittency which is partially developed here.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“large deviation theories”、“Macroscopic Fluctuation Theory”、“derive a new large deviation principle”等理论框架，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：弱波湍流（weak wave turbulence）中谱的动力学涨落，特别是局域波相互作用下的典型与稀有涨落，以及非平衡谱周围的高斯涨落结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在局域弱波湍流中，围绕非平衡谱的高斯涨落方程存在长程关联，可分解为三种贡献：由体通量驱动、由外驱动力及其可能涨落驱动，以及平衡贡献。这些长程关联首次在仅固定通量的边界条件下被计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在局域弱波湍流中，围绕非平衡谱的高斯涨落方程存在长程关联，可分解为三种贡献：由体通量驱动、由外驱动力及其可能涨落驱动，以及平衡贡献。这些长程关联首次在仅固定通量的边界条件下被计算。；创新点：首次在仅固定通量的边界条件下计算了非平衡谱周围长程关联的三种贡献，并提供了可复现的分析方法。此外，将该理论推广至非均匀波湍流，为解释某些一维非均匀四波相互作用模型（如Majda-McLaughlin-Tabak模型）中Kolmogorov-Zakharov谱的不稳定性提供了可能。
papers.method_zh: 基于大偏差理论（large deviation theory）的简化框架，推导了局域波相互作用下的新大偏差原理，并利用该理论分析高斯涨落方程的结构。该方法可视为宏观涨落理论（Macroscopic Fluctuation Theory）的推广形式，但包含质量和能量两个守恒量。

papers.title: Spectral analysis of equilibration: information leakage in isolated quantum systems
papers.abstract: We develop a unified dynamical-spectral framework for equilibration in isolated quantum systems based on a subspace coarse-graining approach. Central to our formulation is the Leakage Fidelity Function (LFF), defined as the probability that a unitarily evolving state escapes the support of its initial subspace. This quantity provides a direct, operational measure of information flow and memory loss without invoking ensemble assumptions or perturbative arguments. We derive universal bounds on temporal fluctuations of the LFF, in terms of the spectral gap structure and the square of the effective dimension, evincing that large spectral delocalization suppresses fluctuations and guarantees equilibration on average. By introducing spectral power distributions and associated entropic measures, we establish a quantitative link between phase mixing, gap participation, and dynamical stability. We further investigate the equilibration timescale by connecting the LFF to quantum speed limits, thereby revealing the average time required for equilibration. Our results provide a state-dependent, geometrically transparent perspective on how spectral complexity and subspace information leakage jointly govern irreversibility in closed quantum many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：dynamical-spectral framework（动力学-谱框架）、subspace coarse-graining approach（子空间粗粒化方法）、theoretical derivation（理论推导）。；研究对象：孤立量子系统中的平衡化（equilibration）过程，具体关注信息泄漏（information leakage）与记忆丢失（memory loss）的动力学机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了泄漏保真度函数（LFF）作为直接度量信息流动和记忆丢失的操作性指标，并证明谱离域化（spectral delocalization）越大则LFF的时间涨落越小，从而保证系统在平均意义上实现平衡化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了泄漏保真度函数（LFF）作为直接度量信息流动和记忆丢失的操作性指标，并证明谱离域化（spectral delocalization）越大则LFF的时间涨落越小，从而保证系统在平均意义上实现平衡化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于子空间粗粒化方法构建统一的动力学-谱理论框架；引入泄漏保真度函数（LFF）作为核心物理量；利用谱间隙结构（spectral gap structure）和有效维度平方（square of effective dimension）推导LFF时间涨落的普适上界；引入谱功率分布（spectral power distributions）及相关熵度量建立相位混合（phase mixing）与动力学稳定性的定量联系；通过连接LFF与量子速度极限（quantum speed limits）分析平衡化时间尺度。

papers.title: Toward Entanglement Bootstrap for Conformal Field Theory in Any Dimension
papers.abstract: Given a quantum critical wavefunction in any dimension, we propose a reconstructed Hamiltonian, analogous to the ones previously found for 1+1d CFT and for 2+1d bosonic liquid topologically-ordered states. We test numerically that, for known regularized approximate CFT groundstates (on the icosahedron and the fuzzy sphere), (1) they are close to the groundstate of their reconstructed Hamiltonian, and (2) the spectrum of their reconstructed Hamiltonian on the unit sphere has CFT properties (integer spacing of descendants) and matches known low-lying energies. We show that this provides an automated method to improve the finite-size effects in a fixed Hilbert space.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算混合类型。关键词：propose（提出理论框架）、test numerically（数值测试）、reconstructed Hamiltonian（重构哈密顿量）。；研究对象：任意维度下的量子临界波函数（quantum critical wavefunction），具体测试了正则化近似CFT基态（在二十面体和模糊球面上）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于任意维度的量子临界波函数，可以构造一个重构哈密顿量，其基态接近原CFT基态，且其谱在单位球面上具有CFT性质（后代整数间距），并匹配已知低能能量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于任意维度的量子临界波函数，可以构造一个重构哈密顿量，其基态接近原CFT基态，且其谱在单位球面上具有CFT性质（后代整数间距），并匹配已知低能能量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造：提出重构哈密顿量（类比于1+1d CFT和2+1d玻色液体拓扑有序态中已有的构造）。数值测试：在二十面体（icosahedron）和模糊球面（fuzzy sphere）上对已知正则化近似CFT基态进行数值验证。

papers.title: Statistical Mechanics and Symmetries of Non-Abelian Anyon Proliferation: From Deformation to Decoherence
papers.abstract: Topological quantum computation relies on braiding non-Abelian anyons, but requires the underlying topological order to survive imperfect state preparation and environmental noise. We show that the instability of topological order to wavefunction deformations and to decoherence, with the latter probed by syndrome distributions, are generically captured by stat-mech models whose symmetries naturally expose the corrupting anyonic excitations. As an example, we combine this framework with Monte-Carlo simulations to resolve the stability of $D_4$ topological order under deformations and quantum channels that proliferate multiple non-Abelian anyon species that individually are unable to condense. We show that beyond a finite threshold, proliferation of two non-Abelian anyon species parasitically condenses a shared Abelian-anyon fusion outcome, destroying the topological order. Our symmetry-based approach sharply differentiates the resulting trivial phase from that obtained by condensing all Abelian charges; in other words, the trivial phase "remembers" which anyons condensed. This framework provides a first step into identifying the relevant symmetry for optimal decoders, conditioned on syndrome measurements, of non-Abelian topological order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：stat-mech models、symmetry-based approach、Monte-Carlo simulations。；研究对象：非阿贝尔任意子增殖的统计力学与对称性，具体以 \( D_4 \) 拓扑序为模型体系，研究其在波函数形变和退相干下的稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当两种非阿贝尔任意子物种增殖超过有限阈值时，会寄生性地凝聚一个共享的阿贝尔任意子融合产物，从而破坏拓扑序；所得的平庸相“记住”了哪些任意子发生了凝聚，与凝聚所有阿贝尔电荷得到的平庸相不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当两种非阿贝尔任意子物种增殖超过有限阈值时，会寄生性地凝聚一个共享的阿贝尔任意子融合产物，从而破坏拓扑序；所得的平庸相“记住”了哪些任意子发生了凝聚，与凝聚所有阿贝尔电荷得到的平庸相不同。；创新点：提出一种基于对称性的框架，能够区分由不同任意子凝聚导致的平庸相，并首次将非阿贝尔拓扑序的稳定性问题与最优解码器的对称性识别联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 构建统计力学模型，利用对称性分析揭示导致拓扑序不稳定的任意子激发；结合蒙特卡洛模拟，研究 \( D_4 \) 拓扑序在波函数形变和量子信道（通过综合征分布探测退相干）下的稳定性。

papers.title: Multi-entropy in heavy local quenches
papers.abstract: We study the time evolution of tripartite entanglement in heavy local quenches in two-dimensional holographic conformal field theories. Our diagnostic is the genuine multi-entropy of adjacent intervals, computed from both bulk and boundary perspectives. A perturbative bulk analysis shows that the first-order small-mass perturbation around the vacuum geodesic network cancels identically at any time after the quench. In the fully back-reacted geometry, a vacuum-subtracted genuine multi-entropy arises from a mismatch between the winding selected by the trivalent geodesic network and the windings selected independently by the pairwise geodesics. In the sharp quench limit, the time dependence of genuine multi-entropy is kinematically fixed to logarithms of rational functions of time and is independent of the heavy operator dimension. The CFT calculation reproduces the same formula within the heavy-light vacuum block approximation, where the branch choice in the heavy-background uniformization map corresponds to the winding selection in the bulk. These results indicate that, in this setup, the genuine multi-entropy is controlled by global saddle selection, rather than by a local energy response or quasiparticle propagation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：holographic conformal field theories（全息共形场论）、bulk analysis（体分析）、CFT calculation（CFT计算）。；研究对象：二维全息共形场论中，由重局域淬火（heavy local quenches）引发的三体纠缠（tripartite entanglement）的时间演化。具体诊断量为相邻区间的“真正多熵”（genuine multi-entropy）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在重局域淬火后，真正多熵的时间演化由全局鞍点选择（global saddle selection）控制，而非局域能量响应或准粒子传播。在尖锐淬火极限下，其时间依赖关系由时间和有理函数的对数固定，且与重算符的维度无关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在重局域淬火后，真正多熵的时间演化由全局鞍点选择（global saddle selection）控制，而非局域能量响应或准粒子传播。在尖锐淬火极限下，其时间依赖关系由时间和有理函数的对数固定，且与重算符的维度无关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用全息对偶方法，从体（bulk）和边界（boundary）两个视角进行计算。体分析中使用了围绕真空测地线网络的微扰展开（perturbative bulk analysis）以及完全反作用（fully back-reacted）几何。边界CFT计算中采用了重-轻真空块近似（heavy-light vacuum block approximation）。

papers.title: Localization of Chiral Electromagnetic Waves on Thick Axion Domain Walls
papers.abstract: We analyze Maxwell theory coupled to an axion domain wall as a spectral boundary value problem. We find that a finite-width axion domain wall generically supports a localized normalizable chiral electromagnetic mode with linear, gapless dispersion. This mode arises from helicity-dependent coupling sourced by the axion gradient: one polarization experiences an effective attractive potential and forms a bound state, while the opposite polarization is repelled. The existence of this chiral surface photon is robust over a wide regime of wall structures and axion masses. Our result shows that axion domain walls generically support a localized chiral photon that has been missed in previous analyses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“analyze Maxwell theory”、“spectral boundary value problem”、“coupled to an axion domain wall”，属于解析理论分析。；研究对象：轴子畴壁（axion domain wall）与电磁波耦合的体系，具体研究有限宽度轴子畴壁上手性电磁波的局域化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限宽度的轴子畴壁普遍支持一种局域化、可归一化的手性电磁模式，该模式具有线性、无能隙的色散关系，且其存在性对畴壁结构和轴子质量具有鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限宽度的轴子畴壁普遍支持一种局域化、可归一化的手性电磁模式，该模式具有线性、无能隙的色散关系，且其存在性对畴壁结构和轴子质量具有鲁棒性。；创新点：发现了此前分析中遗漏的、轴子畴壁普遍支持的局域化手性光子模式（chiral surface photon），该模式源于轴子梯度对不同极化电磁波产生吸引或排斥的有效势。
papers.method_zh: 将麦克斯韦理论与轴子畴壁耦合作为谱边界值问题（spectral boundary value problem）进行解析分析，通过轴子梯度产生的螺旋度依赖耦合（helicity-dependent coupling）来研究不同极化电磁波的有效势。

papers.title: Infinite-Order Lattice Chiral Anomalies and CPT
papers.abstract: A key property of a global symmetry's anomaly is its order: the smallest integer $n$ for which the diagonal symmetry of the $n$-copy system is anomaly-free. While many familiar lattice anomalies have finite order, perturbative anomalies in the continuum$-$those captured by Feynman diagrams$-$have infinite order. In this paper, we show that the Onsager symmetry, a lattice realization of the chiral symmetry of a 1+1d massless Dirac fermion, has an order-two anomaly. However, imposing lattice CPT symmetry enhances this anomaly from order two to infinite order, yielding a lattice chiral symmetry structure that more faithfully matches the continuum chiral anomaly. We also discuss the corresponding 2+1d symmetry-protected topological phases for these infinite-order lattice anomalies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：lattice anomalies、symmetry-protected topological phases、continuum chiral anomaly。；研究对象：1+1维无质量狄拉克费米子的手征对称性在格点上的实现（Onsager对称性），以及其反常（anomaly）的阶数；同时涉及对应的2+1维对称性保护拓扑相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Onsager对称性在格点上具有二阶反常，但若同时施加格点CPT对称性，该反常会从二阶增强为无穷阶，从而更忠实地复现连续统中的手征反常结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Onsager对称性在格点上具有二阶反常，但若同时施加格点CPT对称性，该反常会从二阶增强为无穷阶，从而更忠实地复现连续统中的手征反常结构。；创新点：揭示了格点CPT对称性可以将原本有限阶（二阶）的格点反常提升为无穷阶，从而在格点体系中实现与连续统微扰反常（无穷阶）更一致的手征反常结构。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过研究格点对称性（Onsager对称性、CPT对称性）与反常阶数的关系，并讨论对应的对称性保护拓扑相（SPT phases）。

papers.title: Boltzmann Attention: Learnable Ising Couplings for Cooperative Attention
papers.abstract: Attention mechanisms are central to modern sequence models, yet standard attention computes relevance primarily through individual query--key similarities. Although softmax normalization introduces competition among positions, a standard attention layer does not explicitly parameterize learnable interactions between attention decisions. This limits its ability to directly model cooperative or antagonistic co-attention structure within the attention mechanism itself. We propose Boltzmann attention, an energy-based generalization in which attention patterns are governed by an interacting Ising model. The method augments the usual data-dependent local fields with learnable pairwise couplings, allowing the model to represent inter-position correlations beyond those captured by softmax or sigmoid attention. Experiments on character-level language modeling and synthetic bracket matching show that Boltzmann attention consistently improves over standard softmax attention within a standard Transformer architecture, with the advantage becoming more pronounced as sequence length increases. A four-way ablation confirms that the improvement arises from the learnable pairwise couplings. These results suggest that explicit inter-position interactions provide a principled enhancement for attention-based sequence modeling. Moreover, the Ising formulation opens a natural path toward quantum-computing-based sampling strategies: we demonstrate that diabatic quantum annealing provides a practical training method while maintaining competitive performance with exact Boltzmann computation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（混合计算）。判断依据：提出能量基模型（Ising模型推广）、理论框架（Boltzmann注意力）、包含实验验证（字符级语言建模与括号匹配任务）及量子退火采样方法。；研究对象：注意力机制中的序列建模问题，具体为通过可学习伊辛耦合（Ising couplings）建模注意力决策间的协同或对抗结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引入可学习成对耦合的Boltzmann注意力机制，在标准Transformer架构中持续优于softmax注意力，且优势随序列长度增加而更显著；消融实验证实改进源于可学习成对耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引入可学习成对耦合的Boltzmann注意力机制，在标准Transformer架构中持续优于softmax注意力，且优势随序列长度增加而更显著；消融实验证实改进源于可学习成对耦合。；创新点：首次在注意力机制中显式参数化可学习的成对相互作用（伊辛耦合），使模型能直接表示位置间相关性（超越softmax/sigmoid的竞争性归一化）；同时为量子计算采样策略（如量子退火）提供自然路径。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于伊辛模型的能量基注意力（Boltzmann注意力），将注意力模式建模为相互作用自旋系统，包含数据依赖的局域场和可学习成对耦合。计算手段：精确Boltzmann计算与diabatic量子退火采样训练。实验验证：字符级语言建模与合成括号匹配任务。

papers.title: A Pfaffian quantum Hall state of ultracold bosons
papers.abstract: Fractional quantum Hall states are a cornerstone of topological physics, hosting fractionally charged quasiparticles with exotic statistics that promise to enable topologically protected quantum information processing. Among these, the Pfaffian state introduced by Moore and Read implements a p-wave pairing structure that supports excitations with non-Abelian exchange statistics. Despite extensive study in electronic systems, direct access to its pairing structure has remained limited. Here we realize a three-particle bosonic Pfaffian state of ultracold $^{87}\mathrm{Rb}$ atoms in an optical lattice subject to a Floquet-engineered synthetic magnetic field. Using a Bayesian-optimized adiabatic protocol, we prepare a state exhibiting Pfaffian pairing correlations. Site-resolved measurements of multi-point density correlations reveal a pronounced suppression of short-range three-body coincidences, reflecting the underlying pairing structure. We further probe the state's transport response through Hall drift measurements. Our results establish a bottom-up approach to engineering non-Abelian topological order and lay the groundwork for future explorations of anyonic braiding in synthetic matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：ultracold atoms, optical lattice, Floquet-engineered, site-resolved measurements, Hall drift measurements。；研究对象：超冷玻色子（$^{87}\mathrm{Rb}$ 原子）在光学晶格中，通过Floquet工程合成磁场实现的分数量子霍尔态，具体为三粒子玻色子Pfaffian态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验上成功制备并表征了一个超冷玻色子的三粒子Pfaffian量子霍尔态，通过多点密度关联测量观察到短程三体重合的显著抑制，证实了其p波配对结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验上成功制备并表征了一个超冷玻色子的三粒子Pfaffian量子霍尔态，通过多点密度关联测量观察到短程三体重合的显著抑制，证实了其p波配对结构。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但相对于电子系统中对Pfaffian态配对结构直接探测的局限性，本工作首次在超冷原子合成体系中实现了对玻色子Pfaffian态配对关联的直接、位点分辨的测量。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用Floquet工程在光学晶格中为超冷$^{87}\mathrm{Rb}$原子合成人工磁场；采用贝叶斯优化的绝热协议制备目标量子态；通过位点分辨的多点密度关联测量探测配对结构；通过霍尔漂移测量探测输运响应。

papers.title: Gate-tunable spin-valley transport via carrier velocity in monolayer WSe$_2$
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate spin- and valley-resolved quantum transport in monolayer tungsten diselenide (WSe$_2$) described by an effective massive Dirac Hamiltonian. Particular attention is devoted to a finite barrier region characterized by simultaneously modulated Fermi velocity and scalar potential. The barrier velocity $v_2$ is related to the external velocity $v_1$ through a velocity ratio $ξ=v_2/v_1$, motivated by an optical analogy with the Snell-Descartes law. The exact refraction condition depends on the full spin- and valley-resolved dispersion, and the simple ratio $ξ=v_2/v_1$ is recovered only in the massless, symmetric limit. The interplay of intrinsic spin-orbit coupling in the conduction and valence bands, quantified by $λ_c$ and $λ_v$, with spin- and valley-dependent Zeeman fields, $M_s$ and $M_v$, gives rise to substantial changes in the quasiparticle dispersion, leading to pronounced modifications of the transport characteristics. By solving the Dirac equation and enforcing current-conserving matching conditions at the interfaces, we compute the spin- and valley-dependent transmission probability and conductance. Our results demonstrate that the barrier velocity, scalar potential, incidence angle, incident energy, and barrier width serve as effective control parameters for transport, giving rise to strong anisotropy and resonant tunneling features. Furthermore, we show that both the magnitude and orientation of spin- and valley-polarized currents can be continuously tuned via velocity and potential modulation. These findings establish combined velocity and potential engineering as a powerful theoretical framework for controlling spin-valley physics in two-dimensional transition-metal dichalcogenides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretically investigate、effective massive Dirac Hamiltonian、solving the Dirac equation。；研究对象：单层二硒化钨（WSe₂）中的自旋-谷分辨量子输运现象，具体为通过调控载流子速度与标量势实现的自旋-谷输运控制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过同时调控势垒区的费米速度与标量势，可以连续调节自旋极化与谷极化电流的大小和方向，并实现强各向异性与共振隧穿特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过同时调控势垒区的费米速度与标量势，可以连续调节自旋极化与谷极化电流的大小和方向，并实现强各向异性与共振隧穿特征。；创新点：引入势垒速度与外部速度的比值ξ（受斯涅尔-笛卡尔定律的光学类比启发），将速度调控与势垒调控相结合，建立了一个控制二维过渡金属硫族化合物中自旋-谷物理的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 基于有效大质量狄拉克哈密顿量描述单层WSe₂，通过求解狄拉克方程并在界面处施加电流守恒匹配条件，计算自旋-谷分辨的透射概率与电导。

papers.title: Effect of polar distortions on the anomalous Hall conductivity of altermagnetic $α$-MnTe
papers.abstract: Altermagnetic $α$-MnTe with Néel vector along the $y$-axis exhibits a finite anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) and weak ferromagnetism along the $z$-axis. As already demonstrated in the bulk, there is the breaking of the C$_6$ symmetry by the in-plane Néel vector, leaving a C$_2$-type magnetic symmetry. The surface of $α$-MnTe breaks the C$_2$, leaving only a time-reversed mirror symmetry with respect to the $x=0$ plane. Therefore, we demonstrate that on the surface, the interplay between breaking of the crystal symmetry and Néel vector orientation produces a reduction of the space group from hexagonal P6$_3$/mmc to orthorhombic Amm2. As a result, the surface exhibits not only a polar distortion along the $z$-axis, but also a polar distortion and a weak ferrimagnetism along the $y$-axis. To describe the surface of MnTe in an accessible way, we simplify the problem and examine the effect of the in-plane electric field in bulk MnTe. Moreover, as a doped ionic semiconductor, the properties of MnTe can be influenced by lattice polarization under an applied electric field. We investigate the interplay between the intrinsic anomalous Hall effect and lattice polarization, showing that polarization effects can substantially affect the AHC. Since the electric field breaks inversion symmetry, this contribution from the lattice polarization coexists with the non-linear anomalous Hall effect, highlighting the rich transport phenomenology of altermagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“demonstrate”“examine”“investigate”等理论分析词汇，并涉及对称性分析、空间群简化、电场效应模拟等理论推导，未提及具体实验手段。；研究对象：反铁磁材料α-MnTe的异常霍尔电导率（AHC）及其与极性畸变的相互作用，特别是表面和体相中晶格极化对输运性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: α-MnTe表面因晶体对称性破缺与奈尔矢量取向的共同作用，导致空间群从六方P6₃/mmc降为正交Amm2，从而在z轴和y轴方向均产生极性畸变及弱铁磁性；外加电场引起的晶格极化可显著影响异常霍尔电导率，并与非线性异常霍尔效应共存。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：α-MnTe表面因晶体对称性破缺与奈尔矢量取向的共同作用，导致空间群从六方P6₃/mmc降为正交Amm2，从而在z轴和y轴方向均产生极性畸变及弱铁磁性；外加电场引起的晶格极化可显著影响异常霍尔电导率，并与非线性异常霍尔效应共存。；创新点：揭示了表面极性畸变与奈尔矢量取向协同导致的空间群降维机制，并首次指出晶格极化效应可显著调控反铁磁体α-MnTe的异常霍尔电导率，且该贡献与非线性异常霍尔效应共存。
papers.method_zh: 对称性分析（空间群降维、时间反演镜像对称性）、简化模型（用体相内电场模拟表面效应）、考虑掺杂离子半导体中晶格极化与电场耦合的理论分析。

papers.title: Approximate additivity in the solvent-mediated potential of mean force for ultrasoft particle systems
papers.abstract: In the infinite dilution limit, we show that the solvent-mediated potential of mean force (PMF) between solutes, extracted from the hypernetted-chain (HNC) closure of the Ornstein-Zernike equations, can expressed as a convolution between solute-specific generalised excluded volume functions. In the limit of a structureless solvent of point particles and hard core solutes, this recovers the exact Asakura-Oosawa depletion potential as the overlap between excluded volume spheres. The methodology can be deployed for ultrasoft particle systems such as those encountered in dissipative particle dynamics (DPD), where the solvent-mediated PMF can be recovered with considerable accuracy. These results confirm that in coarse-grained molecular DPD simulations the parametrisation of the non-bonded repulsions is sensitive to the assumed intramolecular bond lengths if they are smaller than the range of the DPD potential, due to the overlap of the soft excluded volume functions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：hypernetted-chain closure、Ornstein-Zernike equations、理论推导、卷积表达）；研究对象：超软粒子系统中溶剂介导的平均力势（PMF），具体涉及耗散粒子动力学（DPD）模拟中的软排斥参数化问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无限稀释极限下，超软粒子系统的溶剂介导PMF可表示为溶质特异性广义排除体积函数的卷积；在粗粒化DPD模拟中，若假设的分子内键长小于DPD势作用范围，非键排斥的参数化会因软排除体积重叠而变得敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无限稀释极限下，超软粒子系统的溶剂介导PMF可表示为溶质特异性广义排除体积函数的卷积；在粗粒化DPD模拟中，若假设的分子内键长小于DPD势作用范围，非键排斥的参数化会因软排除体积重叠而变得敏感。；创新点：将原本适用于硬球体系的排除体积重叠思想推广至超软粒子系统，并证明该卷积方法可高精度恢复DPD体系中的溶剂介导PMF。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于Ornstein-Zernike方程的超网链（HNC）闭包理论，推导溶剂介导PMF的卷积表达式；并与点粒子结构溶剂及硬核溶质情况下的精确Asakura-Oosawa耗尽势进行对比验证。

papers.title: Plasmonic properties and correlation energies from a compact multipole representation of the dielectric response in 2D metals
papers.abstract: Multipole-Padé approximants provide a compact representation of dynamical response functions in terms of a small number of collective modes. Here, we generalize this framework to incorporate momentum dependence across the full Brillouin zone of 2D metals by constructing a symmetry-conserving, anisotropic representation of the inverse dielectric function. This analytic form enables efficient and accurate evaluation of quantities involving dynamical screening, including spectral features and correlation energies. We construct such compact representations for a set of seven two dimensional metals spanning distinct electronic regimes, and show that a small number of dispersive plasmonic modes suffices to accurately describe the dielectric response across the full Brillouin zone, while also yielding accurate correlation energies. The proposed representation therefore establishes a direct bridge between {\it ab initio} calculations and analytical models of screening, opening new avenues for applications in condensed matter systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“构建解析形式”、“计算关联能”、“第一性原理计算”等关键词，属于理论建模与计算分析范畴。；研究对象：二维金属中的等离激元特性与关联能。具体体系为一组跨越不同电子态区域的七种二维金属。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过构建一种紧凑的多极子表示（Multipole-Padé近似），仅需少量色散等离激元模式即可精确描述二维金属在整个布里渊区内的介电响应，并能准确计算其关联能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过构建一种紧凑的多极子表示（Multipole-Padé近似），仅需少量色散等离激元模式即可精确描述二维金属在整个布里渊区内的介电响应，并能准确计算其关联能。；创新点：将多极子-帕德近似推广到包含整个布里渊区的动量依赖关系，建立了一个连接第一性原理计算与解析屏蔽模型之间的直接桥梁，为凝聚态体系中的相关应用开辟了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用多极子-帕德近似（Multipole-Padé approximants）框架，通过构建一个保持对称性、各向异性的逆介电函数解析形式，来描述二维金属的动力学响应。该方法将响应函数压缩为少数集体模式的表示，并用于计算光谱特征和关联能。

papers.title: Mass generation at a fixed point: A Functional Renormalization Group Study of the tricritical O($N$) model in $d=3$ and $N=\infty$
papers.abstract: Renormalization group (RG) fixed points are commonly associated with scale invariance and a divergent correlation length. We show that this connection can fail in the tricritical $O(N)$ model in three dimensions in the limit $N\to\infty$. Revisiting the line of fixed points identified by Bardeen, Moshe, and Bander, we use the functional renormalization group to clarify the mechanism leading to mass generation at its singular endpoint (the BMB fixed point). We demonstrate that the generated mass is nonuniversal and originates from the nonanalytic structure of the effective potential. We show that the critical exponent $ν$ which takes the value $ν= 1/2$ along the regular part of the BMB line, that is, for $0 \leq λ< λ_{\rm BMB}$, jumps to $ν= 1/3$ on the singular part of this line with the BMB FP, corresponding to $λ= λ_{\rm BMB}$, being the pivotal point between these two regimes. We also show how its singular potential emerges dynamically along the renormalization flow.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Functional Renormalization Group Study（泛函重整化群研究）、理论模型分析。；研究对象：三维空间中的三临界O(N)模型，在N→∞极限下的固定点性质，特别是Bardeen-Moshe-Bander（BMB）固定点处的质量生成机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三维三临界O(N)模型的N→∞极限下，重整化群固定点与标度不变性及发散关联长度的通常联系可能失效；在BMB固定点处产生的质量是非普适的，源于有效势的非解析结构，且临界指数ν在BMB线正则部分（ν=1/2）与奇异部分（ν=1/3）之间发生跳跃。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三维三临界O(N)模型的N→∞极限下，重整化群固定点与标度不变性及发散关联长度的通常联系可能失效；在BMB固定点处产生的质量是非普适的，源于有效势的非解析结构，且临界指数ν在BMB线正则部分（ν=1/2）与奇异部分（ν=1/3）之间发生跳跃。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用泛函重整化群（Functional Renormalization Group, FRG）方法，重新审视Bardeen、Moshe和Bander先前识别的固定点线，分析有效势的非解析结构及重整化流中奇异势的动态涌现过程。

papers.title: Substrate insulated Josephson junctions for superconducting quantum circuits
papers.abstract: We have developed a fabrication technique for Josephson junctions that employs a three-dimensional patterned, low-loss substrate instead of commonly used organic resists. The technique enables the fabrication of high-quality trilayer junctions from a wide range of geometries and materials, including high-melting-point superconductors such as tantalum or niobium. The junction electrodes are free from intentionally introduced oxides and organic materials, which are known sources of decoherence. We fabricate and characterize underdamped Nb/AlOx/Nb junctions of different sizes in several geometries. Such junctions enable manufacturing of quantum circuits operating at higher speeds and elevated temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“开发了一种制备技术”、“制备并表征了不同尺寸的Nb/AlOx/Nb结”等实验内容。；研究对象：用于超导量子电路的约瑟夫森结，具体为Nb/AlOx/Nb三层膜结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过使用三维图案化的低损耗衬底替代传统有机抗蚀剂，成功制备出高质量、无有机残留和人为氧化层的约瑟夫森结，该结可用于制造更高速度和更高温度下运行的量子电路。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过使用三维图案化的低损耗衬底替代传统有机抗蚀剂，成功制备出高质量、无有机残留和人为氧化层的约瑟夫森结，该结可用于制造更高速度和更高温度下运行的量子电路。；创新点：使用低损耗衬底替代有机抗蚀剂进行结的图形化制备，从而避免了有机材料和人为引入的氧化物（已知的退相干来源）对结电极的污染。
papers.method_zh: 采用三维图案化低损耗衬底作为掩模的约瑟夫森结制备技术，制备了欠阻尼的Nb/AlOx/Nb三层膜约瑟夫森结，并对其进行了电学表征。

papers.title: Superconductivity in the pressure-amorphized topological insulator CrP$_4$
papers.abstract: The interplay among superconductivity, magnetism, and nontrivial band topology represents one of the most compelling frontiers in condensed matter physics. The exploration of novel superconductivity in 3d transition-metal compounds, particularly the rare Cr-based systems containing strongly magnetic Cr ions, has long attracted attention owing to their unconventional pairing mechanisms that challenge conventional wisdom. Yet, Cr-based superconductors remain scarce, especially those possessing nontrivial topological character, underscoring the urgent need to uncover new members. Here we report the observation of superconductivity in pressure-amorphized Cr-based topological insulator CrP$_4$. Upon compression, CrP$_4$ undergoes an anomalous quantum phase transition from a metallic to a semiconducting-like state at around 15 GPa, driven by significant changes in the electronic structure. At approximately 70 GPa, re-metallization with superconductivity occurs alongside an irreversible amorphization. The superconducting transition temperature Tc increases monotonically with pressure, reaching 4.8 K at 141.3 GPa. Furthermore, theoretical calculations predict multiple topological phase transitions from a strong topological insulator to a trivial state and finally back to a strong topological state under pressure. Our study not only establishes CrP$_4$ as the first Cr-based amorphous superconductor but also opens a new paradigm for exploring superconducting and topological properties in amorphous materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：observation, report, compression, theoretical calculations）；研究对象：Cr基拓扑绝缘体CrP₄在高压下的超导电性及非晶化过程
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在压力诱导下，CrP₄经历金属-半导体转变、不可逆非晶化，并在约70 GPa出现超导电性，最高超导转变温度达4.8 K（141.3 GPa），成为首个Cr基非晶超导体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在压力诱导下，CrP₄经历金属-半导体转变、不可逆非晶化，并在约70 GPa出现超导电性，最高超导转变温度达4.8 K（141.3 GPa），成为首个Cr基非晶超导体。；创新点：首次在Cr基化合物中实现非晶态超导电性，并揭示压力下强拓扑绝缘体-平庸态-强拓扑态的多重拓扑相变，为在非晶材料中探索超导与拓扑性质开辟新范式。
papers.method_zh: 高压实验（压缩至141.3 GPa）、电阻/超导转变测量、理论计算（预测拓扑相变）

papers.title: Stacking switching between correlation-protected radial Rashba field and persistent spin textures in graphene encapsulated by 1T-TaS$_2$ monolayers
papers.abstract: We investigate the electronic structure, spin textures, and charge to spin/orbital transport in graphene encapsulated by 1T-TaS$_{2}$ monolayers in the charge density wave phase. Using first-principles calculations, tight-binding modeling, and the Kubo formalism, we show that the encapsulation stacking dictates fundamentally distinct transport regimes. In the asymmetrical (AA) stacking, proximity fields from both interfaces constructively interfere, yielding a cumulative Rashba phase of nearly $π/2$. This pure radial Rashba spin pattern leads to the unconventional Rashba-Edelstein effect, which robustly dominates over the conventional response by a factor of 35 across a wide energy range. Conversely, the symmetrical (AA') stacking preserves a horizontal mirror symmetry, establishing a stable, purely out-of-plane persistent spin texture. Furthermore, the computed orbital Hall effect is exceptionally efficient, surpassing the spin Hall effect by three orders of magnitude. Within the proximity-induced spectral gaps, the orbital Hall conductivity exhibits a finite plateau, whereas the spin Hall conductivity vanishes. Our findings establish graphene encapsulated heterostructures as a promising system for realizing distinct charge to spin and charge to orbital interconversion regimes determined by the choice of stacking order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论文章。关键词：first-principles calculations, tight-binding modeling, Kubo formalism。；研究对象：被1T-TaS₂单层（处于电荷密度波相）包裹的石墨烯异质结中的电子结构、自旋织构以及电荷-自旋/轨道输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 包裹堆叠方式（AA与AA'）决定了截然不同的输运机制：AA堆叠产生累积的径向Rashba自旋织构，导致非常规Rashba-Edelstein效应；AA'堆叠则形成稳定的纯面外持久自旋织构。此外，轨道霍尔效应效率极高，比自旋霍尔效应高出三个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：包裹堆叠方式（AA与AA'）决定了截然不同的输运机制：AA堆叠产生累积的径向Rashba自旋织构，导致非常规Rashba-Edelstein效应；AA'堆叠则形成稳定的纯面外持久自旋织构。此外，轨道霍尔效应效率极高，比自旋霍尔效应高出三个数量级。；创新点：揭示了通过选择不同的堆叠顺序（AA vs AA'），可以在同一石墨烯异质结体系中实现截然不同的电荷-自旋与电荷-轨道相互转换机制，并发现了由堆叠决定的径向Rashba场与持久自旋织构之间的切换。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算、紧束缚模型、Kubo形式论。

papers.title: Thermodynamically consistent phase field model for hydrogen-assisted cracking
papers.abstract: We propose a phase field model able to simulate hydrogen-assisted cracking in polycrystalline materials. Within a variational framework, the model simultaneously describes crack propagation and hydrogen segregation on crack surfaces and grain boundaries together with the associated reduction in interfacial energies. In the context of hydrogen-enhanced decohesion (HEDE) mechanisms, we demonstrate the ability of the model to capture the transition from transgranular cracking to hydrogen-assisted intergranular cracking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：phase field model（相场模型）、variational framework（变分框架）、simulate（模拟）。；研究对象：多晶材料中的氢致开裂（hydrogen-assisted cracking）现象，具体涉及裂纹扩展、氢在裂纹表面和晶界的偏析，以及氢增强内聚减弱（HEDE）机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型能够捕捉从穿晶开裂到氢致晶间开裂的转变，验证了其在氢增强内聚减弱机制下的描述能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型能够捕捉从穿晶开裂到氢致晶间开裂的转变，验证了其在氢增强内聚减弱机制下的描述能力。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于变分框架的相场模型（phase field model），同时描述裂纹扩展、氢在裂纹表面和晶界的偏析，以及由此引起的界面能降低。

papers.title: Tunable Snapping and Rigid Foldability in the Mars Origami Pattern
papers.abstract: Origami-inspired metamaterials exploit the interplay between geometry and elasticity to achieve programmable mechanical responses. Yet the origin and tunability of snap-through instabilities in non-rigidly foldable patterns remain poorly understood. Here we show that the Mars tessellation, a degree-4 vertex origami pattern composed of alternating square and rhombic faces, is not rigidly foldable because the folding-speed ratios required for vertex compatibility cannot be propagated consistently across neighboring units. This geometric incompatibility forces the facets to bend during folding, giving rise to a reproducible snap-through discontinuity in the force-displacement curve with a mean force drop of about 92.6 +/- 5.5 %, marking a transition between metastable states. Laser scoring of additional diagonal creases, guided by strain-field simulations, enables continuous tuning of the snap magnitude. These results reveal a general mechanism by which geometric frustration can be harnessed to program multistability in thin-sheet metamaterials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要提及“激光刻划额外对角线折痕”的实验操作，以及“应变场模拟”的计算指导。；研究对象：火星折纸图案（Mars origami pattern）——一种由正方形和菱形面交替组成的四度顶点折纸镶嵌结构，及其在折叠过程中产生的突跳不稳定性与多稳态力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 火星折纸图案因几何不兼容性导致非刚性折叠，在力-位移曲线中产生可重复的突跳不连续性（平均力降约92.6±5.5%），且通过激光刻划额外折痕可连续调控突跳幅度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：火星折纸图案因几何不兼容性导致非刚性折叠，在力-位移曲线中产生可重复的突跳不连续性（平均力降约92.6±5.5%），且通过激光刻划额外折痕可连续调控突跳幅度。；创新点：揭示了非刚性可折叠折纸图案中几何受挫（geometric frustration）如何被利用来编程薄片超材料的多稳态行为，并首次实现了对突跳幅度的连续调控。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用激光刻划在薄片材料上引入额外对角线折痕；计算上利用应变场模拟指导折痕位置设计；通过力-位移曲线测量表征突跳行为。

papers.title: Enhanced localization length in a disordered one-dimensional band via cavity coupling to delocalized states
papers.abstract: We investigate the localization properties of cavity-coupled electronic states in disordered systems, motivated by recent proposals of cavity-mediated hopping in quantum Hall systems. We first introduce a minimal two-band model in which localized states in a disordered one-dimensional band are coupled, through a homogeneous cavity mode, to an excited band of delocalized states. Combining perturbation theory with a transfer-matrix approach, we show that cavity-assisted hopping between localized states decays exponentially with distance, implying that the eigenstates remain localized even beyond the perturbative regime. Nevertheless, the corresponding localization length increases with the light-matter coupling strength and can extend over several lattice sites in the single-electron ultrastrong-coupling regime. We then study a disordered Landau band coupled to a cavity mode within the framework developed in Refs.[1,2]. We find that the effective cavity-mediated coupling between edge states also decays exponentially with distance, but with a localization length that can reach micrometer scales for experimentally realistic parameters. By analyzing the inverse participation ratio, we show that this enhanced coupling is predominantly mediated by the most extended states of the upper Landau band. Our results demonstrate that, while cavity-induced hopping in disordered quantum Hall systems remains exponentially localized, the associated localization length can become sufficiently large for the corresponding states to exhibit effectively delocalized behavior on mesoscopic length scales.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词包括“perturbation theory”、“transfer-matrix approach”、“analyzing the inverse participation ratio”，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：腔耦合无序电子系统的局域化性质，具体包括一个无序一维能带中的局域态与一个离域态激发能带通过均匀腔模耦合的模型，以及无序朗道能带与腔模耦合的量子霍尔系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 腔辅助跳跃在无序系统中仍呈指数衰减，因此本征态保持局域化；但光-物质耦合强度可显著增大局域化长度，在单电子超强耦合下可覆盖多个晶格位点，在量子霍尔系统中可达微米尺度，从而在介观尺度上表现出有效离域行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：腔辅助跳跃在无序系统中仍呈指数衰减，因此本征态保持局域化；但光-物质耦合强度可显著增大局域化长度，在单电子超强耦合下可覆盖多个晶格位点，在量子霍尔系统中可达微米尺度，从而在介观尺度上表现出有效离域行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合微扰理论与转移矩阵方法分析局域化长度；通过逆参与率（inverse participation ratio）分析态的空间扩展程度；并基于文献[1,2]的框架研究无序朗道能带与腔模的耦合。

papers.title: Structural responses incipient to pressure-driven antiferromagnetic quantum critical point of van der Waals heavy-fermion metal CeSiI
papers.abstract: CeSiI is a van der Waals heavy-fermion metal recently found to exhibit unconventional superconductivity near a pressure-induced antiferromagnetic quantum critical point (QCP) at Pc =6 GPa. Here, we report a comprehensive single-crystal X-ray diffraction study of CeSiI under high pressures up to 8.3 GPa at room temperature, revealing subtle structural responses that precede pressure-driven QCP. We find that the unit-cell volume decreases smoothly upon compression without showing any structural phase transition in the investigated pressure range. Intriguingly, we observe abrupt and concurrent anisotropic responses of the lattice parameters around Pc =6 GPa, i.e., the a-axis contracts while the c-axis enlongated suddenly, with the unit-cell volume smoothily varies with pressure. Structural refinements further show that these lattice anomalies primarily originate from changes of Ce-Ce and Ce-Si bond lengths, as well as a flattening of the inner honeycomb Si layer within the CeSiI monolayer around Pc. Our findings establish an interesting case linking pressure-driven electronic transition of QCP at low temperatures to incipient structural responses at room temperature, thereby providing fresh insight into the pressure-temperature phase diagram of CeSiI.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：single-crystal X-ray diffraction study、high pressures、room temperature。；研究对象：范德瓦尔斯重费米子金属 CeSiI，具体研究其在压力驱动反铁磁量子临界点（QCP）附近的晶格结构响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在室温下，CeSiI 在压力接近 6 GPa 的量子临界点处未发生结构相变，但观察到晶格参数的突然且各向异性的异常变化（a 轴收缩、c 轴伸长），这些结构响应与低温下的电子相变存在关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在室温下，CeSiI 在压力接近 6 GPa 的量子临界点处未发生结构相变，但观察到晶格参数的突然且各向异性的异常变化（a 轴收缩、c 轴伸长），这些结构响应与低温下的电子相变存在关联。；创新点：首次在室温下发现 CeSiI 中与压力驱动量子临界点相关的晶格结构前兆响应，建立了低温电子相变与室温结构响应之间的关联，为理解 CeSiI 的压力-温度相图提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 高压单晶 X 射线衍射（XRD）实验，压力范围最高至 8.3 GPa，在室温下进行。通过结构精修分析键长和层内原子位置变化。

papers.title: Quantum dynamic simulation of triplet formation in an effective model of Y6 (BTP-4F)
papers.abstract: We construct a five-state model for photoexcitation in Y6 (BTP-4F) dimers, and then solve the non-adiabtic dynamics using the Hierarchical Equations of Motion (HEOM) method. We find that triplets are populated mainly via a transiently excited \textit{intermolecular} charge-transfer singlet to triplet Frenkel exciton route; this route is not available to the monomer. Analysis of one-particle transition density matrices suggests that the charge-transfer states are spatially distinct to the Frenkel exciton states, indicating that the large spin-orbit-coupling for this transition is due to it being permitted by an associated change in orbital character. Aggregation in Y6 therefore directly enables fast and high-yield intersystem crossing. We selenise our model dimers, significantly enhancing spin-orbit-coupling, which then accelerates this charge-transfer mediated route. Looking forwards to simulations on larger aggregates, we show that, though Marcus theory gives qualitatively correct dynamics, the long-time yields are incorrect due to it missing quantum recurrences. Instead, we show that the recently developed memory-kernel projector\cite{Gestsson2025-ez} method can produce semi-classical rates directly from the HEOM equations which lead to quantitatively correct dynamics and yields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：construct a five-state model、solve the non-adiabatic dynamics、Hierarchical Equations of Motion (HEOM) method。；研究对象：Y6 (BTP-4F) 二聚体中的光激发与三线态形成动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Y6 二聚体中三线态主要通过一个瞬态激发的分子间电荷转移单线态到 Frenkel 激子三线态的路径生成，该路径在单体中不存在；聚集直接实现了快速且高产率的系间窜越。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Y6 二聚体中三线态主要通过一个瞬态激发的分子间电荷转移单线态到 Frenkel 激子三线态的路径生成，该路径在单体中不存在；聚集直接实现了快速且高产率的系间窜越。；创新点：揭示了 Y6 二聚体中一种新的、由分子间电荷转移态介导的三线态生成路径，并指出该路径因伴随轨道特征变化而具有大自旋-轨道耦合；同时展示了记忆核投影方法能从 HEOM 方程直接给出半经典速率，从而获得定量正确的动力学和产率，弥补了 Marcus 理论因忽略量子回波而导致的长期产率错误。
papers.method_zh: 构建了 Y6 二聚体的五态模型，采用分层运动方程（HEOM）方法求解非绝热动力学；通过单粒子跃迁密度矩阵分析态的空间分布；对模型进行硒化以增强自旋-轨道耦合；对比了 Marcus 理论和记忆核投影方法的动力学结果。

papers.title: Weakly interacting Bose gases in the canonical ensemble
papers.abstract: Based on the canonical description of a non-interacting Bose gas, we work out how both thermodynamic and statistical properties change perturbatively with respect to weak two-particle interactions. Up to first order, we obtain a recursion formula for the canonical partition function, which consists of the same Feynman diagrams as the grand-canonical description but with different Feynman rules. Resumming this recursion formula for the canonical partition function allows one to characterize the statistics of the ground-state occupancy by its respective cumulants. We demonstrate the applicability of this approach by analyzing a dilute Bose gas with contact interaction in a box trap. To this end, we used Dirichlet boundary conditions in view of their relevance for current experiments with atomic gases, where the box trap is implemented, for instance, with digital mirror devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“canonical description”、“perturbatively”、“recursion formula”、“Feynman diagrams”、“resumming”。；研究对象：弱相互作用的玻色气体，具体为盒状陷阱中的稀薄接触相互作用玻色气体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在正则系综框架下，通过微扰方法推导出弱相互作用玻色气体的配分函数递推公式，该公式与巨正则系综的费曼图结构相同但规则不同，并利用该递推公式表征了基态占据数的统计性质（累积量）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在正则系综框架下，通过微扰方法推导出弱相互作用玻色气体的配分函数递推公式，该公式与巨正则系综的费曼图结构相同但规则不同，并利用该递推公式表征了基态占据数的统计性质（累积量）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于无相互作用玻色气体的正则系综描述，采用微扰论处理弱两体相互作用，推导出正则配分函数的一阶递推公式，并对其进行重求和以计算基态占据数的累积量。边界条件采用狄利克雷边界条件。

papers.title: Kinetic kagome magnetism: from self-trapping RVB polarons to semiclassical correlations
papers.abstract: To gain deeper insight into the role of hole kinetics in determining magnetism in highly frustrated doped Mott insulators, we consider the single-hole counter-Nagaoka problem on the kagome lattice, using magnetization as a tuning parameter. Near full polarization, a doped hole delocalizes upon binding reversed spins in a pattern of singlet bonds which we term resonating-valence-bond (RVB) polaron. These RVB polarons can have extremely small effective bandwidths, and hence exhibit self-trapping. By tuning the spin polarization, we track the evolution of these states toward the unpolarized sector, where we observe the emergence of $\sqrt{3}\times\sqrt{3}$ antiferromagnetic correlation reminiscent of the classical Potts and Heisenberg models on the kagome lattice.
