These results provide a framework to understand how RVB physics at short scales evolves into conventional magnetic correlations at long scales.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：consider、theoretical framework、semiclassical correlations。；研究对象：高度受挫掺杂Mott绝缘体中的空穴动力学与磁性的关系，具体以kagome晶格上的单空穴反Nagaoka问题为体系，以磁化强度为调控参数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在近全极化条件下，掺杂空穴通过束缚反转自旋形成共振价键（RVB）极化子而实现退局域化，这些RVB极化子具有极小的有效带宽并表现出自陷行为；随着自旋极化降低，系统演化出与经典Potts和Heisenberg模型类似的√3×√3反铁磁关联，揭示了短程RVB物理向长程常规磁关联的演化机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在近全极化条件下，掺杂空穴通过束缚反转自旋形成共振价键（RVB）极化子而实现退局域化，这些RVB极化子具有极小的有效带宽并表现出自陷行为；随着自旋极化降低，系统演化出与经典Potts和Heisenberg模型类似的√3×√3反铁磁关联，揭示了短程RVB物理向长程常规磁关联的演化机制。；创新点：首次在kagome晶格上系统研究了空穴动力学驱动的RVB极化子自陷行为，并建立了从短程RVB物理到长程常规磁关联（√3×√3反铁磁序）的连续演化图像。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，通过磁化强度作为调控参数，研究单空穴在kagome晶格上的反Nagaoka问题，追踪从近全极化到非极化区域的状态演化。

papers.title: Roughening of active nonlinear interfaces with broken tilt symmetry
papers.abstract: We study the roughening of an interface with nonlinear elasticity driven by temporally correlated noise, which breaks statistical tilt symmetry. Using scaling arguments and a self-consistent Hartree approximation, we derive the crossover diagram and the steady-state structure factor. We identify three scaling regimes associated with the Larkin, anharmonic Larkin, and Edwards--Wilkinson universality classes, and obtain the crossover lengths separating them. Numerical simulations of large systems confirm the analytical predictions over the full parameter range. Our results provide a unified description of finite-size and crossover effects in a minimal nonlinear-elastic Ornstein--Uhlenbeck active interface.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值模拟）。判断依据：关键词“scaling arguments”、“self-consistent Hartree approximation”、“numerical simulations”。；研究对象：具有非线性弹性、受时间关联噪声驱动的活性界面，该体系破坏了统计倾斜对称性（statistical tilt symmetry）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该界面粗糙化过程存在三种标度行为区域，分别对应Larkin、非谐Larkin和Edwards-Wilkinson普适类，并获得了分隔这些区域的交叉长度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该界面粗糙化过程存在三种标度行为区域，分别对应Larkin、非谐Larkin和Edwards-Wilkinson普适类，并获得了分隔这些区域的交叉长度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 标度论证（scaling arguments）、自洽Hartree近似（self-consistent Hartree approximation）以及大规模数值模拟。

papers.title: Experimental straintronics in nanotube quantum dots
papers.abstract: Single-wall carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) are narrow ribbons of graphene with atomically precise edges and a single quantum transport channel, at experimentally-relevant dopings. This makes them ideal systems to harness quantum transport straintronics (QTS), i.e. using mechanical strain to control accurately quantum transport. We present QTS data from three single-wall carbon nanotube quantum dot (SWCNT-QD) transistors over a broad range of in-situ tunable and reversible uniaxial strain ($Δ\varepsilon_\text{mech}\approx$ 0 to 3 %). We first present the nanofabrication of the suspended SWCNT transistors whose channel lengths are $\approx$ 30 nm. The channels are strained by moving gold clamps holding firmly the nanotubes. We present detailed charge transport data, $dI/dV_{\text{B}} - V_{\text{B}} - V_{\text{G}}$ and $dI/dV_{\text{B}} - V_{\text{B}} - Δ\varepsilon_\text{mech}$, showing a large mechanical-gating effect of the SWCNT-QDs. The precise reversibility of the data, and their agreement with QTS theory, confirms that the tubes are strained elastically. We demonstrate that the mechanical control of the QD doping is not due to capacitive-gating effects, but to quantitatively predictable bandstructure changes including a strain-tunable bandgap. This precise mechanical control of the doping and bandgap of SWCNT-QDs could find applications in qubits, condensed matter physics, and homojunction molecular transistors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“present QTS data”、“nanofabrication”、“present detailed charge transport data”等实验数据与器件制备描述。；研究对象：单壁碳纳米管量子点（SWCNT-QD）晶体管中的量子输运应变电子学（QTS）现象，即利用机械应变精确调控量子输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过施加可逆单轴应变（约0-3%），实现了对单壁碳纳米管量子点的机械门控效应，证明应变对量子点掺杂的调控并非源于电容门控，而是源于可定量预测的能带结构变化（包括应变可调带隙）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过施加可逆单轴应变（约0-3%），实现了对单壁碳纳米管量子点的机械门控效应，证明应变对量子点掺杂的调控并非源于电容门控，而是源于可定量预测的能带结构变化（包括应变可调带隙）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上制备了沟道长度约30纳米的悬空单壁碳纳米管晶体管，通过移动固定纳米管的金夹钳施加应变，并测量微分电导（dI/dV_B）随偏压（V_B）、栅压（V_G）和机械应变（Δε_mech）的变化图谱。

papers.title: Path convergence in diffusion models
papers.abstract: We discuss diffusion-model paths interpolating between a target distribution known only through p patterns and a reference distribution that can be sampled. These interpolating paths can be constructed symmetrically or else in forward direction (often referred to as a "noising") from the target patterns to the reference distribution or in backward direction (as a "denoising") from the reference distribution to the patterns. For backward paths with identical diffusion noise, we consider the path convergence in number of patterns p towards the path for infinitely many patterns. In a one-dimensional test case, we show that this convergence is on a scale 1/sqrt(p), but with infinite mean square deviation. We demonstrate that the path convergence allows for extrapolation towards the p=infinity path which samples the target distribution. We provide a proof-of-concept extrapolation algorithm and propose the convergence and extrapolation of paths as a possible strategy for density estimation and generalization. We illustrate all our algorithms through pseudo-codes and provide Python implementations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：讨论、证明、提出算法、提供伪代码）；研究对象：扩散模型中的路径收敛问题，具体研究在有限样本（p个模式）下，从目标分布到参考分布（或反向）的插值路径随p增大时的收敛行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在一维测试案例中，路径收敛的尺度为1/√p，但均方偏差发散（无穷大）；基于路径收敛可实现向p=∞路径的外推，从而采样目标分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在一维测试案例中，路径收敛的尺度为1/√p，但均方偏差发散（无穷大）；基于路径收敛可实现向p=∞路径的外推，从而采样目标分布。；创新点：提出利用扩散模型路径的收敛性进行外推（向p=∞路径），并以此作为密度估计与泛化的一种可能策略。摘要未突出说明与已有扩散模型理论的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析（一维测试案例的收敛尺度与均方偏差推导）、概念验证外推算法、伪代码与Python实现。

papers.title: Grand-canonical phase diagram and chiral-current suppression at $π$ flux in a bosonic two-leg ladder
papers.abstract: We investigate the ground-state phase diagram of repulsively interacting bosons on a two-leg ladder threaded by a uniform artificial magnetic flux, using the cluster Gutzwiller mean-field method. In the strong-rung-coupling regime, self-consistent calculations are performed on a $2\times4$ cluster. By analyzing the superfluid order parameter, leg-resolved currents, chiral current, the current ratio on adjacent legs, and the density imbalance between the two legs, we distinguish Mott-insulating from superfluid regimes and characterize the observed states as Meissner-like, vortex-like (superfluid or Mott insulating), or biased-ladder. In regions overlapping with previous DMRG studies, our results qualitatively agree with the established phase structure, demonstrating that the cluster Gutzwiller approach balances computational efficiency and physical accuracy. We then construct the first grand-canonical $t$--$μ$ phase diagrams for this system, revealing how the magnetic flux modifies the shape, tilt, and extent of the Mott lobes. We further explore previously inaccessible regimes, including higher fillings $ρ\gtrsim1$ and the intermediate interaction window $U/t\in[7.69,9.09]$. Special attention is paid to $\varphi=π$, where the effective triangular-ladder mapping becomes singular. Owing to the equivalence of $\varphi=π$ and $-π$ modulo $2π$, a combined symmetry forbids net chiral currents, leading to a nonchiral Mott-insulating state, in contrast to the chiral-superfluid tendency expected away from $\varphi=π$. Our results offer a computationally efficient route for mapping the global phase structure of bosonic flux ladders and provide guidance for future ultracold-atom experiments in artificial gauge fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用 cluster Gutzwiller mean-field method 进行自洽计算，构建相图。；研究对象：人工磁场下双腿梯子中相互排斥的玻色子体系，重点研究其基态相图及手性电流行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在磁通 φ=π 时，由于 φ=π 与 -π 模 2π 等价，组合对称性禁止净手性电流，导致非手性莫特绝缘态，与远离 φ=π 时的手性超流趋势形成对比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在磁通 φ=π 时，由于 φ=π 与 -π 模 2π 等价，组合对称性禁止净手性电流，导致非手性莫特绝缘态，与远离 φ=π 时的手性超流趋势形成对比。；创新点：首次构建了该体系的巨正则 t-μ 相图，揭示了磁通如何改变莫特瓣的形状、倾斜和范围；并探索了之前难以触及的高填充区（ρ≳1）和中等相互作用区间（U/t∈[7.69,9.09]）。
papers.method_zh: 采用团簇 Gutzwiller 平均场方法，在强横档耦合条件下对 2×4 团簇进行自洽计算，通过分析超流序参量、腿分辨电流、手性电流、相邻腿电流比及两腿密度不平衡来区分不同相。

papers.title: Tracking atomic-scale interdiffusion in immiscible bimetallic nanoparticles via four-dimensional electron tomography
papers.abstract: The interdiffusion of immiscible elements is generally considered both thermodynamically unfavorable and kinetically hindered. At the nanoscale, however, the mixing behavior of multielements materials often diverges from bulk equilibrium, yet a quantitative, atomically resolved description of this transformation has remained challenging. Using ex situ four dimensional atomic resolution electron tomography combined with in situ scanning transmission electron microscopy, here we reveal the atomic scale miscible transition driven by interdiffusion in immiscible PdIr nanoparticles at temperatures far below the melting point. The pathway involves surface reconstruction atom hopping at 200oC and surface flattening at 300oC, followed by a critical transition at 400oC where Ir interfacial diffusion and discrete Ir intermediates drive miscible intermixing. Upon reaching the nanoscale melting point 900oC, collective inward Ir diffusion yields the thermodynamically stable IrPd configuration. Our findings provide quantitative atomic scale insights into how metastable nanostructures evolve through distinct intermediates, offering a design framework for advanced multielement materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“ex situ four dimensional atomic resolution electron tomography combined with in situ scanning transmission electron microscopy”等实验手段。；研究对象：不混溶双金属纳米颗粒（PdIr纳米颗粒）中的原子尺度互扩散行为及其导致的混溶转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在远低于熔点的温度下，不混溶的PdIr纳米颗粒可通过表面重构、原子跳跃、界面扩散及离散中间体等路径实现原子尺度的混溶转变，最终在纳米尺度熔点（900°C）时形成热力学稳定的IrPd构型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在远低于熔点的温度下，不混溶的PdIr纳米颗粒可通过表面重构、原子跳跃、界面扩散及离散中间体等路径实现原子尺度的混溶转变，最终在纳米尺度熔点（900°C）时形成热力学稳定的IrPd构型。；创新点：首次在原子尺度上定量揭示了不混溶双金属纳米颗粒在远低于熔点的温度下，通过一系列明确的中间态（表面重构、原子跳跃、界面扩散等）实现混溶转变的完整路径，为设计亚稳态多元素纳米材料提供了定量框架。
papers.method_zh: 离位四维原子分辨率电子断层扫描（4D electron tomography）结合原位扫描透射电子显微镜（in situ STEM）。

papers.title: Structural Changes and Transport Properties of $\mathrm{YBa_2Cu_3O_7}$ Locally Modified by a He$^+$ Focused Ion Beam
papers.abstract: Irradiation of a material with ions can cause various defects that can lead to structural phase transitions and the modification of the material's properties. Here we study the irradiation of the epitaxyally grown thin films of the high-temperature superconductor $\mathrm{YBa_2Cu_3O_7}$ with $30\,\mathrm{keV}$ He$^{+}$ ions which leads to the expansion of the crystal lattice, decrease of the critical temperature $T_c$ and eventually transition to an insulator. Fabrication of such insulating regions with a focused He-Ion beam with a spot size of $\sim 10\,\mathrm{nm}$ is a powerful technique for fabrication of superconducting nano-devices. Using low-temperature resistivity measurements, diffraction with a nanofocused X-ray beam and atomic force microscopy, we investigated how the structure and the electric transport properties of $\mathrm{YBa_2Cu_3O_7}$ depend on the irradiation dose in a range $10$--$100\,\mathrm{ions/nm^2}$ and on the lateral size of the irradiated area in a range $30$--$5000\,\mathrm{nm}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“低温电阻率测量”、“纳米聚焦X射线衍射”、“原子力显微镜”等实验手段。；研究对象：高温超导体YBa₂Cu₃O₇（YBCO）外延薄膜，经30 keV He⁺聚焦离子束辐照后产生的结构变化与电输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: He⁺离子辐照导致YBCO晶格膨胀、超导临界温度Tc下降，并最终使材料转变为绝缘体；辐照剂量和辐照区域的横向尺寸共同影响结构及电输运性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：He⁺离子辐照导致YBCO晶格膨胀、超导临界温度Tc下降，并最终使材料转变为绝缘体；辐照剂量和辐照区域的横向尺寸共同影响结构及电输运性质。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 低温电阻率测量、纳米聚焦X射线衍射、原子力显微镜。辐照剂量范围为10–100 ions/nm²，辐照区域横向尺寸范围为30–5000 nm。

papers.title: From Topological Order to Mixed-State Phases: A Ground-State Probe of Fractionalized Excitations
papers.abstract: How do we detect topological phases from a single ground state? Entanglement entropy and spectrum have long been the standard tools -- but the reduced density matrix (RDM) itself contains far more information. We show that the RDM of a 2D topologically ordered system, expressed at the entanglement cut, realizes a 1D mixed-state phase. For the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ toric code phase, it is a 1D $\mathbb{Z}_2$ strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SW-SSB) phase, where deconfinement of anyons manifests as the short-range correlation of both $\mathbb{Z}_2$ charge and $\mathbb{Z}_2$ domain-wall in the RDM. The bulk $e$-$m$ duality translates into a Kramers--Wannier self-duality of the SW-SSB phase. Extending the framework to gapped $\mathbb{Z}_2$ spin liquids, the global spin-rotation symmetry manifests as an additional weak symmetry for the 1D RDM. Spin-$\frac{1}{2}$ spinons result in a cusp on the disorder parameter of spin-rotation at $θ=π$, providing a direct, ground-state signature of symmetry fractionalization. We verify this prediction analytically using the matrix product density operator formalism and numerically for the kagome-lattice resonating valence bond state. The proposed observable requires only a single ground-state wavefunction, making it amenable to quantum simulation platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及理论分析（如“entanglement entropy and spectrum”、“matrix product density operator formalism”），以及数值验证（“numerically for the kagome-lattice resonating valence bond state”），但无实验手段描述。；研究对象：二维拓扑有序系统（以$\mathbb{Z}_2$ toric code相和$\mathbb{Z}_2$自旋液体为例）的基态约化密度矩阵所实现的一维混合态相，以及其中任意子激发和对称性分数量子化的探测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 二维拓扑有序系统的约化密度矩阵在纠缠切割处实现了一维混合态相，其中任意子的退禁闭表现为$\mathbb{Z}_2$电荷和畴壁的短程关联；自旋-1/2自旋子会在自旋旋转的无序参数于$\theta=\pi$处产生一个尖点，从而提供对称性分数量子化的直接基态信号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：二维拓扑有序系统的约化密度矩阵在纠缠切割处实现了一维混合态相，其中任意子的退禁闭表现为$\mathbb{Z}_2$电荷和畴壁的短程关联；自旋-1/2自旋子会在自旋旋转的无序参数于$\theta=\pi$处产生一个尖点，从而提供对称性分数量子化的直接基态信号。；创新点：提出仅需单个基态波函数即可探测拓扑序和对称性分数量子化的新方法，无需依赖纠缠熵或谱，且适用于量子模拟平台。摘要未突出说明与已有纠缠谱方法的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：利用约化密度矩阵构造一维混合态相，分析强到弱自发对称性破缺（SW-SSB）相；采用矩阵乘积密度算符形式进行解析验证；数值方法：对kagome格点共振价键态进行数值计算。

papers.title: All-electric picosecond field-free spin-orbit torque switching in magnetic trilayers
papers.abstract: Spin-orbit torque (SOT) enables the electrical manipulation of the magnetization with high speed and low energy consumption for magnetic random-access memory (MRAM) applications. Previous studies of short-pulse SOT switching have mainly focused on the nanosecond regime, whereas reports employing picosecond pulses remain scarce and have largely relied on field-assisted switching using bulky, high-power laser systems, limiting prospects for chip-level integration. Here, we introduce an all-electrical on-chip nanoplasma pulse generator capable of producing pulses as short as 6.4 ps, enabling ultrafast picosecond field-free SOT switching in magnetic trilayers. We show that reducing the pulse width lowers the writing energy by 2-3 orders of magnitude, with ultrafast Joule heating assistance playing an essential role in the enhanced efficiency of the picosecond regime. Our demonstration of ultrafast, all-electrical, and field-free SOT switching establishes the nanoplasma pulse generator as an on-chip platform for ultrafast spintronic studies, with promise for high-speed, energy-efficient, and scalable SOT-MRAM technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体实验装置（全电学片上纳米等离子体脉冲发生器）和实验测量（皮秒脉冲SOT开关、写入能量降低等）。；研究对象：磁性三层膜（magnetic trilayers）中的自旋轨道矩（SOT）超快开关现象，具体涉及全电学、无外场辅助的皮秒级磁化翻转。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过片上纳米等离子体脉冲发生器产生短至6.4皮秒的电脉冲，首次实现了全电学、无外场辅助的皮秒级自旋轨道矩开关，且将写入能量降低了2-3个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过片上纳米等离子体脉冲发生器产生短至6.4皮秒的电脉冲，首次实现了全电学、无外场辅助的皮秒级自旋轨道矩开关，且将写入能量降低了2-3个数量级。；创新点：首次在皮秒时间尺度实现全电学、无外场辅助的SOT开关，替代了以往依赖大功率激光系统的场辅助开关方案；揭示了超快焦耳热辅助效应对皮秒区间开关效率提升的关键作用，为片上集成超快自旋电子学研究提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：自行设计的全电学片上纳米等离子体脉冲发生器（产生6.4 ps超短脉冲），结合磁性三层膜结构进行超快SOT开关实验。摘要未明确说明具体材料成分或薄膜制备方法。

papers.title: Scalable Conformal MoSx Catalyst for Efficient Hydrogen Evolution at Industrial-Level Current Density in Alkaline Electrolyzers
papers.abstract: The development of simple and scalable fabrication strategies for cost-effective electrodes is crucial to advance water splitting in alkaline water electrolyzers (AWEs). Here, we present a coating-annealing method to conformally coat a MoSx catalyst layer onto a porous Ni foam (NF) substrate. By controlling the annealing process, the composition of the MoSx layer could be tuned from MoS2 to MoS3 and its catalytic performance for hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) in alkaline media was optimized. The MoS3@NF synthesized by this method achieved industrially relevant HER current densities of 200 mA/cm2 at a low overpotential of 246 mV, maintaining stable operation for over 240 h. The MoS3@NF cathode, combined with a stainless steel anode, enabled an alkaline water electrolyzer (AWE) cell to operate steadily at 1.96 V and 1 A/cm2 for 1000 h. This performance surpasses that of most of the previously reported water electrolyzers employing MoSx-based cathodes. Our work demonstrates the potential of MoS3 (with its abundant edge-sulfur atoms serving as active sites) as a high-performance cathode material for industrial AWEs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：coating-annealing method、synthesized、electrochemical performance、stable operation。；研究对象：MoSx催化剂层（具体为MoS3）涂覆在多孔泡沫镍（NF）基底上，用于碱性水电解中的析氢反应（HER）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调控退火工艺制备的MoS3@NF电极在碱性介质中实现了工业级电流密度（200 mA/cm²）下低过电位（246 mV）的析氢性能，并能在1 A/cm²下稳定运行1000小时，性能优于大多数已报道的MoSx基阴极。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调控退火工艺制备的MoS3@NF电极在碱性介质中实现了工业级电流密度（200 mA/cm²）下低过电位（246 mV）的析氢性能，并能在1 A/cm²下稳定运行1000小时，性能优于大多数已报道的MoSx基阴极。；创新点：提出了一种简单、可扩展的涂覆-退火策略，实现了MoSx催化剂在泡沫镍上的共形涂覆，并通过组分调控优化了催化性能；首次展示了MoS3（而非更常见的MoS2）在工业级电流密度下作为高效、稳定阴极材料的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 采用涂覆-退火方法在泡沫镍上共形沉积MoSx层，通过控制退火过程调节MoSx的组成（从MoS2到MoS3），并测试其碱性HER催化性能。组装了以MoS3@NF为阴极、不锈钢为阳极的碱性水电解槽进行长期稳定性测试。

papers.title: Direct nanoscale observation of melting and solute redistribution in a hypoeutectic Al-Cu alloy with $\it{in\ situ}$ STEM
papers.abstract: Melting and solidification of eutectic systems are classical topics in physical metallurgy, yet the mechanisms at nanoscale are less investigated, due to experimental limitations in spatiotemporal resolution. The advent of $\it{in\ situ}$ STEM heating with MEMS technology has recently enabled investigation of eutectic behavior as a function of temperature, time and electrical resistivity. Using this methodology, we investigate the evolution of a nanocrystalline hypoeutectic Al-Cu alloy. Melting initiated in the hotter central region and propagated outward, with grain boundaries acting as preferred sites for eutectic liquid formation via Cu enrichment. The Al$_2$Cu phase melted prior to complete matrix melting. Liquid-state Cu redistribution over a distance of 258 $μ$m - several orders of magnitude beyond solid-state diffusion limits - resulted in Al-rich rim accumulations and Cu enrichment at the outermost edge of the observed chip region. These observations are discussed in the context of classical predictions for melting of eutectic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：in situ STEM、实验观察、MEMS技术。；研究对象：亚共晶Al-Cu合金在纳米尺度下的熔化过程及溶质再分布行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 熔化从较热的中心区域开始向外扩展，晶界因铜富集成为共晶液相的优先形成位点；液态铜在远超过固态扩散极限的距离（258 μm）上发生再分布，导致富铝边缘和芯片最外缘的铜富集。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：熔化从较热的中心区域开始向外扩展，晶界因铜富集成为共晶液相的优先形成位点；液态铜在远超过固态扩散极限的距离（258 μm）上发生再分布，导致富铝边缘和芯片最外缘的铜富集。；创新点：利用高时空分辨的原位STEM技术，首次在纳米尺度直接观察亚共晶Al-Cu合金熔化过程中晶界优先成核、Al₂Cu相先于基体熔化以及长程液态铜再分布现象，突破了传统固态扩散极限的认知。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于MEMS技术的原位扫描透射电子显微镜（in situ STEM）加热方法，结合温度、时间与电阻率测量，实时观察纳米晶亚共晶Al-Cu合金的熔化与溶质演化。

papers.title: Proximity-induced unconventional superconductivity and chiral topological phases in twisted graphene/NbSe$_2$ van der Waals heterostructure
papers.abstract: We study proximity-induced unconventional superconductivity in a twisted graphene/NbSe$_2$ van der Waals heterostructure using the Bogoliubov-de Gennes formalism. The normal-state parameters of proximitized graphene are extracted from ab initio calculations at a twist angle of $23.4^\circ$, which reduces the common symmetry of the heterostructure to $\mathbf{C}_3$. We construct symmetry-allowed superconducting gap functions of the graphene layer according to the irreducible representations of the $\mathbf{C}_3$ group, containing singlet and triplet pairing channels and their mixtures. Computing the topological invariants as a function of the mixing parameters, we find a rich phase diagram of chiral topological superconducting phases, characterized by nonzero Chern numbers $C\in\{-4,-2,2,4\}$. While the nature of the superconducting order parameter of NbSe$_2$ remains debated, the formation of the van der Waals heterostructure and the related symmetry reduction can alter the relative stability of competing pairing channels, potentially stabilizing a chiral component that is proximity-induced into graphene and triggers the topological phases identified here, making the twisted graphene/NbSe$_2$ heterostructure a promising platform for chiral topological superconductivity detectable via quasiparticle interference imaging and transport measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“Bogoliubov-de Gennes formalism”（理论框架）和“ab initio calculations”（第一性原理计算）等关键词。；研究对象：扭曲的 graphene/NbSe₂ 范德华异质结。具体研究在该异质结中，由于邻近效应诱导产生的非常规超导性以及手性拓扑超导相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过计算拓扑不变量（陈数），发现在扭曲的 graphene/NbSe₂ 异质结中，存在一个丰富的、由不同配对通道混合参数调控的手性拓扑超导相图，其陈数 C 可以取值为 -4, -2, 2, 4。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过计算拓扑不变量（陈数），发现在扭曲的 graphene/NbSe₂ 异质结中，存在一个丰富的、由不同配对通道混合参数调控的手性拓扑超导相图，其陈数 C 可以取值为 -4, -2, 2, 4。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容推断，创新点在于：1）揭示了在特定扭转角下，由于异质结形成导致的对称性降低（从高对称性降至 C₃），可以改变不同配对通道的相对稳定性，从而稳定原本在 NbSe₂ 中可能不占主导的手性配对分量。2）通过邻近效应将这种手性超导性引入石墨烯层，并预言了可被实验探测（如准粒子干涉成像和输运测量）的丰富手性拓扑相。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用 Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) 形式论进行理论建模。正常态参数通过第一性原理计算（ab initio calculations）在特定的扭转角（23.4°）下提取。根据异质结的 C₃ 对称性，构建了对称性允许的超导能隙函数（包括单态和三重态配对及其混合）。

papers.title: Non-Hermitian Delocalization Realizes Random Dirac Criticality in One Dimension
papers.abstract: Non-Hermitian systems can evade Anderson localization and exhibit delocalized states even in one dimension. Here, we show that such non-Hermitian delocalized states under periodic boundary conditions (PBC) are intrinsically critical, realizing the universality class of one-dimensional random Dirac fermions. By linking spectral winding to topological Anderson transitions via Hermitization, we demonstrate that the delocalized PBC states exhibit a Dirac-type criticality with universal algebraic correlations. In contrast to Hermitian systems, where this criticality occurs only at fine-tuned transition points, it emerges generically in non-Hermitian systems as a consequence of spectral topology. These results identify a universal mechanism by which non-Hermiticity promotes criticality, providing a unified description of non-Hermitian delocalization in one dimension.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“linking spectral winding to topological Anderson transitions via Hermitization”、“universality class”、“universal algebraic correlations”等理论分析术语，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：一维非厄米系统中的退局域化现象，具体为周期性边界条件下非厄米退局域态所实现的随机狄拉克费米子普适类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非厄米系统在周期性边界条件下的退局域态本质上是临界态，属于一维随机狄拉克费米子的普适类；与厄米系统仅在精细调谐的相变点出现临界性不同，非厄米系统中这种临界性因谱拓扑而普遍存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非厄米系统在周期性边界条件下的退局域态本质上是临界态，属于一维随机狄拉克费米子的普适类；与厄米系统仅在精细调谐的相变点出现临界性不同，非厄米系统中这种临界性因谱拓扑而普遍存在。；创新点：揭示了非厄米性促进临界性的普适机制，为一维非厄米退局域化提供了统一的理论描述。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或数值方法的对比。
papers.method_zh: 通过厄米化（Hermitization）方法将谱缠绕数与拓扑安德森转变联系起来，分析非厄米退局域态的临界行为与普适代数关联。

papers.title: Multilayer Screening of Double and Conventional Perovskite Solar Cells Using SCAPS-1D and Machine Learning: Optimization of ETL, HTL, and Absorber for High-Efficiency Architectures
papers.abstract: The combinatorial design space of multilayer perovskite solar cells is vast, yet exhaustive experimental or computational screening of all possible material combinations remains impractical. Here, we integrate SCAPS-1D device simulations with machine learning to systematically explore 125 device architectures constructed from five electron transport layers (ETL), five absorbers (including lead-free double perovskites), and five hole transport layers (HTL). A representative subset of configurations is used to train a machine learning (ML) model, which predicts the power conversion efficiency (PCE) of the remaining unexplored structures. Leave-One-Group-Out cross-validation yields a Spearman rank correlation, demonstrating reliable ranking capability. SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) analysis reveals that the HTL band gap, absorber band gap, and ETL electron affinity are the most influential descriptors, providing physical insights into interfacial recombination and charge extraction. The machine learning model identifies several high-performance configurations that are subsequently verified by full SCAPS-1D simulations. Among them, the device FTO/TiO$_2$/Cs$_2$AgBiBr$_6$/NiO/Ag achieves a PCE of 28.85%, and the ML-suggested structure FTO/SnO$_2$/Cs$_2$AgInBr$_6$/NiO/Ag exhibits 28.62%, outperforming a closely related literature architecture by approximately 4% absolute. Notably, eight of the top-11 structures employ the lead-free double perovskite Cs$_2$AgInBr$_6$. This work demonstrates that a physics-based, data-driven workflow combining SCAPS-1D, ML, and SHAP can accelerate the discovery of high-efficiency, environmentally friendly perovskite solar cells while providing transparent design rules. The approach is generalizable to other multilayer optoelectronic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：SCAPS-1D device simulations, machine learning, SHAP analysis）；研究对象：多层钙钛矿太阳能电池，包括五种电子传输层（ETL）、五种吸收层（含无铅双钙钛矿）和五种空穴传输层（HTL）组合而成的125种器件结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过SCAPS-1D模拟与机器学习相结合，筛选出高效无铅双钙钛矿太阳能电池结构，其中FTO/TiO₂/Cs₂AgBiBr₆/NiO/Ag器件效率达28.85%，FTO/SnO₂/Cs₂AgInBr₆/NiO/Ag器件效率达28.62%，且前11种高效结构中有8种采用无铅双钙钛矿Cs₂AgInBr₆。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过SCAPS-1D模拟与机器学习相结合，筛选出高效无铅双钙钛矿太阳能电池结构，其中FTO/TiO₂/Cs₂AgBiBr₆/NiO/Ag器件效率达28.85%，FTO/SnO₂/Cs₂AgInBr₆/NiO/Ag器件效率达28.62%，且前11种高效结构中有8种采用无铅双钙钛矿Cs₂AgInBr₆。；创新点：将SCAPS-1D物理模拟与机器学习及SHAP可解释性分析相结合，系统筛选125种多层钙钛矿器件结构，并揭示HTL带隙、吸收层带隙和ETL电子亲和能为最关键性能描述符，为高效环保钙钛矿太阳能电池提供透明设计规则。
papers.method_zh: SCAPS-1D器件模拟、机器学习（ML）模型训练与预测、留一组交叉验证（Leave-One-Group-Out cross-validation）、SHAP（SHapley Additive exPlanations）特征重要性分析。

papers.title: When and how particles are removed by drops
papers.abstract: Particulate contaminants decrease the power output of solar panels, the transparency of windows, and are detrimental to microelectronics, where even a single particle can induce a short circuit. Despite significant research on particle adhesion and self-cleaning, it remains unclear when and how a drop can remove a particle from a surface, thus efficiently cleaning the surface. Here, by combining lattice Boltzmann simulations and confocal microscopy experiments, we show that at least six different scenarios arise from the complex interplay between capillary and friction forces when a drop collides with a particle. Notably, the capillary force plays a dual role in particle removal: while its tangential component always drives removal, its normal component can also hinder it. By introducing a dimensionless capillary capture parameter, we can predict particle removal across a wide range of particle and surface properties. These results provide quantitative design principles for easy-to-clean surfaces that minimize water and chemical usage.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：lattice Boltzmann simulations（计算）、confocal microscopy experiments（实验）。；研究对象：液滴撞击表面时移除固体颗粒的物理过程，具体涉及毛细力与摩擦力之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 液滴移除表面颗粒至少存在六种不同情景，毛细力的切向分量始终促进移除，但其法向分量可能阻碍移除；引入无量纲“毛细捕获参数”可预测不同颗粒与表面性质下的移除行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：液滴移除表面颗粒至少存在六种不同情景，毛细力的切向分量始终促进移除，但其法向分量可能阻碍移除；引入无量纲“毛细捕获参数”可预测不同颗粒与表面性质下的移除行为。；创新点：揭示了毛细力在颗粒移除中的双重作用（切向促进、法向阻碍），并提出了一个可定量预测颗粒是否被移除的无量纲参数（毛细捕获参数），为设计易清洁表面提供了定量设计原则。
papers.method_zh: 格子玻尔兹曼模拟（lattice Boltzmann simulations）与共聚焦显微镜实验（confocal microscopy experiments）相结合。

papers.title: Heisenberg-Langevin theory of an exciton mirror
papers.abstract: We develop a Heisenberg-Langevin theory of an exciton mirror accounting for the retardation and the long-range electron-hole exchange. A particular case of a strong transverse magnetic field is analyzed in detail. The optical bistability due to repulsion between the excitons inside the light cone appears to be prone to a modulational instability towards the non-radiative surface polariton modes. Above the corresponding threshold, the pumped 2D exciton gas acts as an optical parametric generator of twin polariton beams. Conversely, below the threshold, the mirror acquires the phase-conjugating properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Heisenberg-Langevin theory（理论框架）、分析（analysed）、理论推导。；研究对象：激子镜（exciton mirror），具体为二维激子气体在强横向磁场下的光学行为，涉及激子间的长程交换相互作用和延迟效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 光锥内激子间的排斥作用导致的光学双稳态易发生调制不稳定性，向非辐射表面极化激元模式转变；高于阈值时，泵浦的二维激子气体充当孪生极化激元光束的光学参量发生器；低于阈值时，激子镜获得相位共轭特性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：光锥内激子间的排斥作用导致的光学双稳态易发生调制不稳定性，向非辐射表面极化激元模式转变；高于阈值时，泵浦的二维激子气体充当孪生极化激元光束的光学参量发生器；低于阈值时，激子镜获得相位共轭特性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用海森堡-朗之万理论（Heisenberg-Langevin theory），考虑延迟效应和长程电子-空穴交换相互作用，并对强横向磁场情形进行详细解析分析。

papers.title: Reflective Metastructure Q-plate for Ultrashort Laser Pulses
papers.abstract: The orbital angular momentum of light is an intriguing property for developing light driven applications. It emerged as an independent degree of freedom by which to manipulate light and, consequently, the interaction of light with matter. Several methods exist for the generation of light carrying orbital angular momentum, mostly employing transmitting or reflecting optical components, which radially modulate the phase profile of the light. As one of such components, transmissive q-plates established themselves as standard elements due to their usability over a broad wavelength range. Here, we present our approach to build a highly reflective q-plate based on a plasmonic metasurface capable of converting orbital angular momentum from the nanostructure to ultrashort laser pulses without temporal broadening. We highlight its working principle over a wide range of wavelengths for reflection under normal and gracing incidence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：plasmonic metasurface（等离激元超表面）、highly reflective q-plate（高反射q板）、working principle（工作原理）。；研究对象：基于等离激元超表面的高反射型q板，用于产生携带轨道角动量的超短激光脉冲。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该反射式超表面q板能够将纳米结构中的轨道角动量转换为超短激光脉冲，且不引起时间展宽，在正入射和掠入射下均可在宽波长范围内工作。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该反射式超表面q板能够将纳米结构中的轨道角动量转换为超短激光脉冲，且不引起时间展宽，在正入射和掠入射下均可在宽波长范围内工作。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用等离激元超表面（plasmonic metasurface）构建高反射q板，通过径向调制光相位分布实现轨道角动量转换，并测试了其在正入射和掠入射下的反射性能。

papers.title: Phonons and magnetism of kagome FeGe probed by nuclear resonant scattering
papers.abstract: Kagome FeGe hosts a $2\times2\times2$ charge-density wave (CDW) that strongly interplays with antiferromagnetic order. Here, we report $^{57}$Fe nuclear resonant scattering measurement to study FeGe across its long-range CDW and incommensurate magnetic transitions. Upon entering the CDW state, hardening of acoustic phonons and optical phonons around 22~meV, 27~meV, and 31~meV are observed in the Fe partial phonon density of states, which can be qualitatively captured by first-principle calculations. Upon entering the incommensurate magnetic phase, neither the phonon density of states nor the hyperfine interaction parameters change significantly, although a subtle feature associated with the incommensurate magnetic order or slow fluctuations is detected in the time-domain Mössbauer spectra. These findings show that the CDW in kagome FeGe significantly modifies its lattice dynamics and magnetism, evidencing an intertwined nature of the spin, charge, and lattice degrees of freedom.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：nuclear resonant scattering measurement、Mössbauer spectra、first-principle calculations 作为辅助）；研究对象：Kagome FeGe 中的电荷密度波（CDW）与反铁磁有序之间的相互作用，以及声子动力学和磁性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 进入 CDW 态后，Fe 的声子态密度在特定能量处出现硬化，而进入非公度磁相后声子态密度和超精细相互作用参数变化不大，但时间域穆斯堡尔谱检测到与非公度磁序或慢涨落相关的细微特征，表明自旋、电荷和晶格自由度之间存在交织。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：进入 CDW 态后，Fe 的声子态密度在特定能量处出现硬化，而进入非公度磁相后声子态密度和超精细相互作用参数变化不大，但时间域穆斯堡尔谱检测到与非公度磁序或慢涨落相关的细微特征，表明自旋、电荷和晶格自由度之间存在交织。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 57Fe 核共振散射实验测量 Fe 的声子态密度，结合第一性原理计算进行定性对比；同时使用时间域穆斯堡尔谱分析超精细相互作用。

papers.title: In Situ Dynamics of the Microscopic Crystallographic Dehydration Pathway in a Model Channel Hydrate, Theophylline
papers.abstract: Solid-state phase transformations in molecular crystal hydrates govern stability and functional performance across a range of applications, including pharmaceutical, agrochemical and coordination framework materials. During dehydration, these hydrates can undergo substantial structural reorganisation involving changes in molecular orientation, intermolecular interactions, and lattice symmetry. Despite extensive study, the microscopic crystallographic pathways by which such transformations proceed remain poorly understood. Here, we investigate the dynamics of solid-state dehydration of theophylline monohydrate as a model molecular hydrate using in situ low-dose scanning electron diffraction (SED). Simultaneous observations of changes in morphology and crystallographic phase and orientation mapped across single particles reveal how complete dehydration proceeds via a two-step, reconstructive topotactic solid-state transformation: anisotropic, surface-specific mass loss of material near water channel sides (suggesting the monohydrate adopts a non-centrosymmetric crystal structure) is followed by surface-localised nucleation and growth of anhydrous form II on the parent monohydrate while preserving similar molecular orientations at a common plane. By providing direct, local crystallographic insight into hydrate dehydration, this work demonstrates how surface-controlled mass loss, morphological changes, and lattice orientation jointly govern solid-state transformations in molecular hydrates. More broadly, it establishes low-dose SED as an effective approach for probing dynamic phase transformations in beam-sensitive molecular crystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“in situ low-dose scanning electron diffraction (SED)”、“simultaneous observations”、“mapped across single particles”。；研究对象：茶碱一水合物（theophylline monohydrate）作为模型分子晶体水合物，其固态脱水过程中的微观晶体学路径与动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 茶碱一水合物的完全脱水通过两步、重构型拓扑固态相变实现：首先是水通道侧附近各向异性、表面特异的质量损失（暗示一水合物具有非中心对称晶体结构），随后在母体一水合物表面局域成核并生长无水II型晶相，同时在共同平面上保持相似的分子取向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：茶碱一水合物的完全脱水通过两步、重构型拓扑固态相变实现：首先是水通道侧附近各向异性、表面特异的质量损失（暗示一水合物具有非中心对称晶体结构），随后在母体一水合物表面局域成核并生长无水II型晶相，同时在共同平面上保持相似的分子取向。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 原位低剂量扫描电子衍射（SED），同时观测单个颗粒的形貌变化、晶体学相变和取向变化。

papers.title: Residual stress gradient in a thin film within the dislocation pile-up theory
papers.abstract: A model for predicting the residual stress gradient in a thin film segment is developed on the basis of the theory of dislocation pile-ups. The initial shear stress within the film is relaxed via the formation of a pile-up of screw dislocations against the impenetrable film-substrate interface. Plastic strain is related to the dislocation density, leading to a fundamental equation, which links the residual stress to this density. The distribution of dislocations within the pile-up for an arbitrary, non-uniform residual stress profile is derived analytically by applying the force balance condition. This results in a singular integro-differential equation for the residual stress profile. The equation is solved numerically by a collocation method for various initial stress distributions: constant, linear, parabolic, and exponential functions. The solutions demonstrate that the established residual stress profile strongly depends on the film segment's thickness-to-width ratio and the initial stress distribution. As this ratio increases, stress relaxation becomes more effective away from the film-substrate interface. In all cases, equilibrium requires a pile-up containing dislocations with both positive and negative Burgers vectors. The total number of dislocations and their density distribution vary significantly with the initial stress profile. This model provides a critical step towards more complex models of residual stress formation in constrained material systems, specifically, thin films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develops a model”（建立模型）、“derived analytically”（解析推导）、“solved numerically”（数值求解），属于理论建模与计算分析。；研究对象：薄膜中的残余应力梯度。具体体系为：在不可穿透的薄膜-基底界面处，通过螺位错塞积的形成来释放初始剪切应力的薄膜片段。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 薄膜中建立的残余应力分布强烈依赖于薄膜片段的厚度-宽度比以及初始应力分布。随着厚度-宽度比增加，远离薄膜-基底界面的应力松弛更有效；在所有情况下，平衡态要求塞积群中同时包含正负Burgers矢量的位错。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：薄膜中建立的残余应力分布强烈依赖于薄膜片段的厚度-宽度比以及初始应力分布。随着厚度-宽度比增加，远离薄膜-基底界面的应力松弛更有效；在所有情况下，平衡态要求塞积群中同时包含正负Burgers矢量的位错。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于位错塞积理论，通过力平衡条件解析推导了任意非均匀残余应力分布下的位错分布函数，得到一个奇异积分-微分方程。采用配置法（collocation method）对常数、线性、抛物线和指数函数等不同初始应力分布下的方程进行数值求解。

papers.title: Estimation of conserved charges for a one dimensional system with inhomogeneous hopping
papers.abstract: Quantum integrability in a system is characterized by a large number of conserved charges. However, finding the conserved charges in a generic quantum system is highly challenging. The integrable matrix theory provides a unified framework to obtain the conserved charges in a certain class of systems. We demonstrate this framework in case of a single-particle system on a 1D finite-sized lattice with inhomogeneous nearest neighbor hopping to study the statistical properties of the system across its chaotic--integrable crossover from the perspective of the conserved charges. The eigenspectrum of our random matrix model is studied first. We then estimate the conserved charges and find their properties throughout the chaotic to integrable transition of the system. We calculate the number of conserved charges across this crossover and observe that it is nearly equal to the size of the system at its integrable limit. Our result suggests that the number of conserved charges, estimated using the integrable matrix theory, can be a measure of quantum integrability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“量子可积性”“随机矩阵模型”“可积矩阵理论”等理论框架，未涉及实验或计算模拟的具体手段。；研究对象：一维有限尺寸晶格上具有非均匀最近邻跳跃的单粒子系统，研究其从混沌到可积的交叉过程中的统计性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用可积矩阵理论估算出的守恒荷数量在系统可积极限下接近系统尺寸，表明该数量可作为量子可积性的度量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用可积矩阵理论估算出的守恒荷数量在系统可积极限下接近系统尺寸，表明该数量可作为量子可积性的度量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用可积矩阵理论（Integrable Matrix Theory）作为统一框架，通过构建随机矩阵模型分析系统的本征谱，并估算守恒荷及其在混沌-可积交叉过程中的性质。

papers.title: Coupling Chirality, Polar Order, and Altermagnetic Spin Splitting in a Hybrid Manganese Chloride
papers.abstract: Hybrid manganese halides enable the coexistence of molecular chirality, polar order, and magnetic exchange within a single lattice. Here, we combine first-principles calculations with spin-space-group analysis to investigate the synthesized enantiomeric pair [(R)/(S)-MPA]2[MnCl4(H2O)] (MPA = beta-methylphenethylammonium). We predict that its compensated magnetic state hosts altermagnetic spin splitting in the nonrelativistic limit, and that the coupled chiral, polar, and magnetic degrees of freedom define a symmetry-related manifold. From this manifold, we derive simple sign rules for the electronic and magneto-optical response: reversing both chirality and polarity, or reversing the magnetic domain alone, inverts the spin splitting throughout the Brillouin zone, whereas reversing chirality alone or polarity alone changes the spin-splitting sign only in symmetry-selected regions. With spin-orbit coupling, reversing chirality or magnetic order flips the Kerr rotation angle, while changing the polar variant leaves it unchanged. These results reveal a chemically accessible route to translate molecular handedness into symmetry-controlled spin splitting and magneto-optical readout in hybrid manganese halides. Critically, we show that the sign and momentum pattern of the splitting are governed by the interplay of the chiral, polar, and magnetic degrees of freedom. This interplay opens the possibility to control the spin splitting through a judicious design of the organic cations, by modulating their chirality and polarity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。依据：关键词“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）、“spin-space-group analysis”（自旋空间群分析）。；研究对象：手性杂化锰氯化物[(R)/(S)-MPA]₂[MnCl₄(H₂O)]（MPA = β-甲基苯乙铵）及其对映体，以及其中手性、极性序与交变磁自旋劈裂的耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非相对论极限下，该材料的补偿磁态存在交变磁自旋劈裂，且自旋劈裂的符号和动量分布由手性、极性和磁自由度之间的耦合决定；通过反转手性与极性、或单独反转磁畴，可全域反转自旋劈裂符号，而单独反转手性或极性仅能在对称性选择的区域改变符号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非相对论极限下，该材料的补偿磁态存在交变磁自旋劈裂，且自旋劈裂的符号和动量分布由手性、极性和磁自由度之间的耦合决定；通过反转手性与极性、或单独反转磁畴，可全域反转自旋劈裂符号，而单独反转手性或极性仅能在对称性选择的区域改变符号。；创新点：揭示了通过有机阳离子的手性和极性设计来调控自旋劈裂的化学途径，并建立了手性、极性与磁自由度耦合对电子和磁光响应（如克尔旋转角）的符号规则。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）结合自旋空间群分析（spin-space-group analysis）。

papers.title: The Kondo effect in ferromagnetic quantum critical CeRh$_6$Ge$_4$
papers.abstract: The mechanism of a pressure-induced quantum critical point in the heavy fermion ferromagnet CeRh$_6$Ge$_4$ has attracted interest, as ferromagnetic quantum criticality in a clean itinerant Ce compound is typically avoided. The localized versus itinerant character of the 4\textit{f} electrons is a key aspect for understanding this behavior. We investigated the electronic structure of the 4\textit{f} shell in CeRh$_6$Ge$_4$ using core-level photoelectron and x-ray absorption spectroscopy, demonstrating the hybridization of Ce 4\textit{f} with the conduction electrons. Linearly polarized x-ray absorption reveals a temperature-dependent linear dichroism consistent with the crystal-electric-field (CEF) sequence as inferred from the static susceptibility. This dichroism cannot be described by an ionic full-multiplet model alone, but is reproduced by including the Kondo effect within a single-impurity Anderson model in the non crossing approximation (SIAM/NCA). The Kondo effect mixes higher lying crystal-field states into a resulting multiorbital ground state with 4\textit{f} occupancy \textit{n}$_f$\,$\sim$\,0.9. Deviations at low temperatures between the measured linear dichroism and calculated dichroism suggest an orbital-dependent Kondo effect. A scenario in which there is a multiorbital ground state and orbital-dependent Kondo hybridization should be a starting point for a model of pressure-induced criticality in CeRh$_6$Ge$_4$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了核心能级光电子能谱（core-level photoelectron spectroscopy）和X射线吸收谱（X-ray absorption spectroscopy）等实验手段。；研究对象：重费米子铁磁体CeRh₆Ge₄中压力诱导的量子临界点，以及4f电子的局域与巡游特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CeRh₆Ge₄中4f电子与传导电子存在杂化，且Kondo效应混合了高能晶场态，形成多轨道基态（4f占据数n_f~0.9）。低温下线性二色性的测量值与计算值存在偏差，暗示存在轨道依赖的Kondo效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CeRh₆Ge₄中4f电子与传导电子存在杂化，且Kondo效应混合了高能晶场态，形成多轨道基态（4f占据数n_f~0.9）。低温下线性二色性的测量值与计算值存在偏差，暗示存在轨道依赖的Kondo效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 核心能级光电子能谱、X射线吸收谱（含线性偏振光）、单杂质安德森模型结合非交叉近似（SIAM/NCA）的理论计算。

papers.title: Interfacial Coupling and Sparse Intercalation of 7-Atom-Wide Armchair Graphene Nanoribbons by N-Heterocyclic Carbene Monolayers
papers.abstract: Graphene nanoribbons (GNRs) synthesized on metal substrates experience electronic coupling and screening from the underlying surface, which, although often weak, can modify their observed properties and complicate their transfer to device-compatible substrates. Intercalation of GNRs by self-assembled monolayers (SAMs) offers a possible route to reduce this interaction. Here, we investigate the intercalation of 7-atom-wide armchair graphene nanoribbons (7-AGNRs) on Au(111) using N-heterocyclic carbenes (NHCs). Low-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy, Raman spectroscopy, and density functional theory calculations reveal that the adsorption geometry of the NHCs strongly influences the intercalation yield for GNRs. Methyl-substituted NHCs form flat-lying dimers that partially intercalate the GNRs, producing locally decoupled segments. In contrast, bulkier isopropyl-substituted NHCs form upright monomers that embed the GNRs within the monolayer, preventing intercalation. The low intercalation yield indicates that lifting the nanoribbon from the Au surface is energetically costly. These results establish molecular adsorption geometry and packing as key parameters controlling intercalation at GNR-metal interfaces, with implications for the rational design of decoupling layers for GNR-based device integration pathways.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合计算）。判断依据：使用了低温扫描隧道显微镜/谱（LT-STM/STS）、拉曼光谱等实验手段，并辅以密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。；研究对象：7原子宽扶手椅型石墨烯纳米带（7-AGNRs）与N-杂环卡宾（NHCs）自组装单分子层在Au(111)表面的界面耦合与插层行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: NHCs的吸附几何构型（平躺二聚体 vs. 直立单体）强烈影响其对7-AGNRs的插层产率：甲基取代的NHCs形成平躺二聚体，可部分插层并局部解耦纳米带；而异丙基取代的NHCs形成直立单体，将纳米带嵌入单分子层中，阻止插层。插层产率低表明将纳米带从金表面抬起在能量上代价高昂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：NHCs的吸附几何构型（平躺二聚体 vs. 直立单体）强烈影响其对7-AGNRs的插层产率：甲基取代的NHCs形成平躺二聚体，可部分插层并局部解耦纳米带；而异丙基取代的NHCs形成直立单体，将纳米带嵌入单分子层中，阻止插层。插层产率低表明将纳米带从金表面抬起在能量上代价高昂。；创新点：揭示了分子吸附几何构型和堆积方式作为控制石墨烯纳米带-金属界面插层的关键参数，为基于GNR的器件集成中解耦层的理性设计提供了依据。
papers.method_zh: 低温扫描隧道显微镜/谱（LT-STM/STS）、拉曼光谱（Raman spectroscopy）、密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Exact distribution of the output of a deep-layered machine
papers.abstract: Deep-layered machines, in which each node computes a Boolean function of all nodes below it, underpin deep learning and digital computation. Yet the statistics of their global output function remain poorly understood. We derive the exact finite-depth distribution of the output of a machine with width $k$ and depth $n$. The distribution depends only on the Hamming weight of the output, and as $n$ increases favors functions with low and high Hamming weights. But this bias peaks at a crossover depth proportional to $2^k$ before collapsing onto the constant functions true and false.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“derive the exact finite-depth distribution”（推导精确分布），属于统计物理与计算理论分析。；研究对象：深度分层机器（deep-layered machines），即每个节点计算其下方所有节点的布尔函数，用于深度学习与数字计算。具体研究其全局输出函数的统计分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出了宽度为 \(k\)、深度为 \(n\) 的机器输出函数的精确有限深度分布。该分布仅依赖于输出的汉明重量，且随深度 \(n\) 增加，分布偏向于低汉明重量和高汉明重量的函数；但这种偏置在深度达到约 \(2^k\) 的交叉点后达到峰值，随后分布坍缩为常数函数 true 和 false。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出了宽度为 \(k\)、深度为 \(n\) 的机器输出函数的精确有限深度分布。该分布仅依赖于输出的汉明重量，且随深度 \(n\) 增加，分布偏向于低汉明重量和高汉明重量的函数；但这种偏置在深度达到约 \(2^k\) 的交叉点后达到峰值，随后分布坍缩为常数函数 true 和 false。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：通过解析方法精确计算深度分层机器输出函数的统计分布，分析其与宽度 \(k\)、深度 \(n\) 及汉明重量的依赖关系。

papers.title: Boron Co-Alloying in AlScN Wurtzite Ferroelectrics: Insights from an 850-Sample Combinatorial Study
papers.abstract: AlScN wurtzite ferroelectrics are promising candidates for energy-efficient non-volatile memory. However, AlScN suffers from a high coercive field and reduced cycling endurance, and the limited tunability of its properties constrains further optimization. Co-doping AlScN with boron offers the promise of independently tailoring the chemical and structural properties, making AlScBN an attractive quaternary system. This material has already been explored for a few selected compositions, however, no systematic study of the full AlScBN compositional space exists. A combinatorial approach consisting of gradient deposition with HiPIMS at low temperatures of 250°C and automatic analysis of film properties allowed us to analyze a total of 850 unique samples within the AlScBN phase space. In addition to a full screening of the materials' chemical and structural properties, we fabricate and characterize combinatorial device libraries. XPS charge transfer analysis experimentally confirms that bond ionicity correlates with a reduction in the coercive field for AlScN and AlScBN systems, opposite trends are instead observed for AlBN. While the films maintain a high remanent polarization of 130-150 μC/cm2, Sc and B co-doping reduces the coercive field from 7 MV/cm to 3 MV/cm. Notably, B co-alloying lowers the amount of Sc needed to lower the coercive field, reducing reliance on this scarce element. In addition, we find that co-alloying with B, notably improves cycling endurance, which is related to a reduction in defect density. These results establish AlScBN as a scalable, CMOS-compatible ferroelectric, positioning it as an interesting alternative to AlScN.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“combinatorial approach consisting of gradient deposition with HiPIMS”、“automatic analysis of film properties”、“fabricate and characterize combinatorial device libraries”。；研究对象：AlScBN（硼共掺杂AlScN）纤锌矿铁电体，具体研究其全组分空间内的化学、结构、铁电及循环耐久性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硼共掺杂可独立调控AlScN的化学与结构性质，在保持高剩余极化（130-150 μC/cm²）的同时将矫顽场从7 MV/cm降至3 MV/cm，并显著提升循环耐久性，同时减少对稀缺元素Sc的依赖。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硼共掺杂可独立调控AlScN的化学与结构性质，在保持高剩余极化（130-150 μC/cm²）的同时将矫顽场从7 MV/cm降至3 MV/cm，并显著提升循环耐久性，同时减少对稀缺元素Sc的依赖。；创新点：首次对AlScBN全组分空间进行系统性研究（共850个独特样品），实验证实键离子性与矫顽场降低的关联在AlScN/AlScBN与AlBN中趋势相反，并发现硼共掺杂可降低降低矫顽场所需的Sc含量。
papers.method_zh: 采用组合材料学方法，包括低温（250°C）HiPIMS梯度沉积、自动薄膜性质分析、XPS电荷转移分析，以及组合器件库的制备与表征。

papers.title: Perspective: The Physics of Active Solids -- From Hamiltonians to Active Matter Models
papers.abstract: The physics of active matter, wherein constituent particles consume energy to generate autonomous motion, has revolutionized non-equilibrium statistical mechanics. While a large body of work has successfully elucidated the behavior of dilute active systems, the dense regime -- characterized by ``active glasses and active solids'' -- presents profound challenges that defy conventional theoretical frameworks. Recent observations reveal two striking features in these dense systems: an apparent enhancement of Mermin-Wagner-Hohenberg (MWH) fluctuations leading to anomalous long-wavelength density fluctuations, and a remarkable correspondence between activity-induced annealing and annealing via oscillatory shear. In this perspective article, we propose a novel approach toward a deeper understanding of dense active matter: by developing active Hamiltonian models as equilibrium reference frameworks, we map out pathways toward non-equilibrium active systems. This strategy allows us to elucidate both the correspondence between driven and active systems and the enhanced MWH fluctuations, which likely arise from a strong coupling between spatially random active forces and long-wavelength density (phonon) modes. We outline a comprehensive roadmap employing complementary approaches, including the active Hamiltonian formalism, comparative studies of oscillatory shear in active and passive solids, and investigations of chiral active matter. Establishing this activity-oscillatory shear correspondence across diverse systems is essential to demonstrate its universality, reveal the underlying large-scale emergent physics, and place our hypothesis on a firmer theoretical ground.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：perspective article, propose a novel approach, theoretical frameworks, hypothesis）；研究对象：密集活性物质体系，具体包括活性玻璃（active glasses）和活性固体（active solids），以及其中出现的反常长波密度涨落和活性诱导退火现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 密集活性物质中表现出两个显著特征：一是Mermin-Wagner-Hohenberg（MWH）涨落的增强导致反常长波密度涨落；二是活性诱导退火与振荡剪切退火之间存在显著对应关系。作者提出，这些现象可能源于空间随机活性力与长波密度（声子）模式的强耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：密集活性物质中表现出两个显著特征：一是Mermin-Wagner-Hohenberg（MWH）涨落的增强导致反常长波密度涨落；二是活性诱导退火与振荡剪切退火之间存在显著对应关系。作者提出，这些现象可能源于空间随机活性力与长波密度（声子）模式的强耦合。；创新点：提出通过构建活性哈密顿量模型作为平衡参考系，系统性地建立从平衡体系到非平衡活性体系的路径，并强调活性-振荡剪切对应关系的普适性验证。
papers.method_zh: 提出“活性哈密顿量模型”（active Hamiltonian models）作为平衡参考框架，并规划了互补研究路线：活性哈密顿量形式论、活性固体与被动固体中振荡剪切的比较研究、手性活性物质研究。

papers.title: Visualizing Transient Ordering Phenomena in Dense Nanoparticle Clouds
papers.abstract: The dynamics of nanoparticles within nanoscale liquid environments exhibit a range of complex phenomena driven by the interplay of processes at varying length scales. While these dynamics have profound technical implications, such as in nanoscale catalytic kinetics, ion-transport pathways in energy storage, and macromolecular crowding in biological systems, real-space imaging of dense, confined nanoparticle assemblies remains a significant challenge. Here, we present a liquid-phase transmission electron microscopy approach in which dense clouds of gold nanoparticles are formed within microfluidic channels, rendering the particle ensemble visible in bright-field electron imaging. This strategy enables direct imaging of different density-dependent particle ordering phenomena, including a local structuring of the colloidal liquid in nanoscale spaces, disordered dynamic clouds at high nanoparticle densities and the reversible formation of superlattice structures. Our results provide a unique window into the complex processes of colloidal self-organization at the nanoscale.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：liquid-phase transmission electron microscopy approach、direct imaging、bright-field electron imaging。；研究对象：纳米颗粒在纳米尺度液体环境中的动态有序化现象，具体为微流控通道内密集金纳米颗粒云中的局域结构、无序动态云及超晶格可逆形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过液相透射电子显微镜直接成像，观察到密集纳米颗粒云中依赖于密度的不同有序化现象，包括纳米空间中的胶体液体局域结构、高密度下的无序动态云以及超晶格结构的可逆形成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过液相透射电子显微镜直接成像，观察到密集纳米颗粒云中依赖于密度的不同有序化现象，包括纳米空间中的胶体液体局域结构、高密度下的无序动态云以及超晶格结构的可逆形成。；创新点：实现了对密集、受限纳米颗粒组装体的实空间直接成像，克服了此前在纳米尺度液体环境中观察此类动态有序化现象的技术挑战。
papers.method_zh: 液相透射电子显微镜（liquid-phase TEM），结合微流控通道形成密集金纳米颗粒云，利用明场电子成像实现实时空间成像。

papers.title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
papers.abstract: Halide double perovskites (A$_2$BB'X$_6$) are a long-known class of materials that has recently been rediscovered for diverse applications, including photovoltaics, photocatalysis, and radiation detection. Their doubled unit cell provides immense chemical tunability, allowing the incorporation of magnetic ions and enabling access to a wide range of electronic-structure features, including different band-edge characters, alignments, and symmetries. Magnetic elements may further introduce spin degrees of freedom and magnetic behaviour, thereby broadening the functional landscape of these compounds. Here, we present the first comprehensive database of spin-polarised electronic-structure data for all halide double perovskites predicted to be stable by the recently introduced $τ$ tolerance factor by Bartel et al. The dataset focuses on the Cs$_2$BB'X$_6$ family, with X = I, Br, Cl, and F, and includes density of states (DOS) for $>$2,500 compounds, calculated using hybrid-functional density functional theory. Among these, 719 compounds exhibit band gaps in the visible range and 118 display half-metallic character. In addition, we provide chemical-bonding analysis using \textsc{lobster}, which provides insights into orbital interactions across the dataset. To facilitate exploration, we further offer UMAP-based visualisations and an interactive app for systematic investigation of chemical composition, electronic structure, and magnetic properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“hybrid-functional density functional theory”（混合泛函密度泛函理论）和“chemical-bonding analysis using lobster”（使用lobster进行化学键分析），均为计算手段。；研究对象：卤化物双钙钛矿（A₂BB'X₆），具体聚焦于Cs₂BB'X₆家族（X = I, Br, Cl, F），包括其自旋极化电子结构、化学键合以及磁性行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作构建了首个涵盖2500多种稳定卤化物双钙钛矿的自旋极化电子结构数据库，其中719种化合物具有可见光范围内的带隙，118种表现出半金属特性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作构建了首个涵盖2500多种稳定卤化物双钙钛矿的自旋极化电子结构数据库，其中719种化合物具有可见光范围内的带隙，118种表现出半金属特性。；创新点：首次系统性地提供了所有被τ容差因子预测为稳定的卤化物双钙钛矿的自旋极化电子结构数据，并整合了化学键合分析，填补了该领域在自旋极化电子结构数据库方面的空白。
papers.method_zh: 采用混合泛函密度泛函理论（hybrid-functional DFT）计算态密度（DOS）；使用lobster程序进行化学键合分析；利用UMAP降维可视化，并开发交互式应用程序用于系统探索。

papers.title: Quantum tidal locking in orbiting Bose-Einstein condensates
papers.abstract: Angular momentum coupling manifests widely in diverse physical systems, underpinning the emergent properties and collective dynamics across different scales. The tidal locking, which originates from the synchronization of rotational and orbital motions, has far-reaching impacts in celestial mechanics, reflecting fundamental processes of angular momentum transfer, energy dissipation, and evolution toward dynamical equilibrium. However, its counterpart in mesoscopic quantum fluids has remained largely unexplored. Here we demonstrate the emergence of quantum tidal locking in Bose-Einstein condensates undergoing central force motion in an anharmonic potential. The condensate follows a well-defined orbital trajectory in a static trap and experiences an effective rotating potential induced by the trap anharmonicity. The sustained geometric squeezing continuously deforms the condensate and drives a self-organized synchronization process, in which the intrinsic rotation gradually locks to the orbital motion. Numerical simulations further reveal the formation of a ring-shaped vortex array over longer timescales, arising from the coherent evolution of the rotating matter wave during the locking dynamics. Our findings establish quantum tidal locking in mesoscopic systems as a robust self-organized mechanism for generating and stabilizing circulating states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：demonstrate、numerical simulations、self-organized synchronization）；研究对象：在非简谐势阱中做中心力运动的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（Bose-Einstein condensates）中的量子潮汐锁定现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非简谐势阱中运动的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体会自发出现量子潮汐锁定，即其内禀转动逐渐与轨道运动同步；在更长时间尺度上，该锁定动力学还会导致环形涡旋阵列的形成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非简谐势阱中运动的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体会自发出现量子潮汐锁定，即其内禀转动逐渐与轨道运动同步；在更长时间尺度上，该锁定动力学还会导致环形涡旋阵列的形成。；创新点：首次在介观量子流体中揭示了潮汐锁定现象的量子对应物，并证明这是一种自组织地产生和稳定循环态（circulating states）的鲁棒机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值模拟（摘要中明确提及“numerical simulations”），具体框架为描述玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体在静态非简谐势阱中轨道运动的量子流体动力学模型。

papers.title: Robust Spin Logic Enabled by Generalized $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ Symmetry in $p$-Wave Magnets
papers.abstract: Unconventional magnets combine the vanishing stray fields of antiferromagnets with the strong spin-splitting of ferromagnets, offering a unique material platform for spintronics. However, a critical challenge in realizing functional spin-logic devices lies in preserving long-range spin coherence against momentum-degrading scattering and gate-induced dephasing. Here, we demonstrate that the intrinsic momentum-dependent exchange field of a three-dimensional $p$-wave magnet can be precisely tuned against gate-induced Rashba spin-orbit coupling to establish a \textit{generalized} $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ spin-rotation symmetry. This emergent conservation law generates a symmetry-protected Persistent Spin Helix (PSH), effectively integrating the high energy scales of 3D bulk magnetic exchange with the macroscopic coherence of symmetry protection. By modeling a synergistic $p$-wave magnetic spin field-effect transistor (spin-FET), we reveal high-visibility Datta-Das conductance oscillations controlled purely by electrical gating. Crucially, our quantum transport simulations confirm that this symmetry-engineered transport regime exhibits exceptional resilience against strong non-magnetic Anderson disorder and geometric variations. These results establish a synergistic paradigm for non-magnetized spintronics, demonstrating how the active integration of spin-orbit coupling and unconventional magnetism can yield disorder-resilient spintronic logic.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：demonstrate, modeling, quantum transport simulations）；研究对象：三维p波磁体（3D p-wave magnet）中的自旋逻辑器件，具体为一种协同p波磁自旋场效应晶体管（spin-FET）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过精确调控p波磁体的内禀动量依赖交换场与栅极诱导的Rashba自旋轨道耦合，可以建立一种广义的SU(2)自旋旋转对称性，从而产生受对称性保护的持久自旋螺旋（PSH），实现高可见度且对无序和几何变化具有鲁棒性的Datta-Das电导振荡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过精确调控p波磁体的内禀动量依赖交换场与栅极诱导的Rashba自旋轨道耦合，可以建立一种广义的SU(2)自旋旋转对称性，从而产生受对称性保护的持久自旋螺旋（PSH），实现高可见度且对无序和几何变化具有鲁棒性的Datta-Das电导振荡。；创新点：首次提出在三维p波磁体中通过主动整合自旋轨道耦合与非常规磁性来工程化广义SU(2)对称性，从而将三维体磁交换的高能量尺度与对称性保护的长程相干性相结合，为构建抗无序的自旋逻辑器件提供了新范式。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与量子输运模拟。具体包括：建立p波磁体与Rashba自旋轨道耦合的协同模型，通过调控实现广义SU(2)对称性；模拟自旋场效应晶体管（spin-FET）中的量子输运，计算电导振荡；引入非磁性安德森无序和几何变化进行鲁棒性测试。

papers.title: Intrinsic Nonreciprocity in Electron-Phonon Interaction Driven Thermoelectric Diodes
papers.abstract: We study an electron-phonon interaction driven thermoelectric diode. The nonreciprocity in this diode arises from the asymmetry between the probabilities of phonon emission and absorption in the electron-phonon interaction, as well as the structural reflection asymmetry. We reveal the intrinsic nature of this nonreciprocity, as the forward and backward electron transport remains asymmetric even when the applied temperature difference is not reversed. This intrinsic nonreciprocity gives rise to two novel transport phenomena. One is a novel thermoelectric effect which is driven by the temperature difference between the leads and the central device region, rather than the conventional temperature difference between the two leads. The second, and more significant, phenomenon is the suppression of electronic backscattering in the load resistor. This suppression decreases the resistance of the load resistor, which leads to the breakdown of Ohm's addition law. Under suitable conditions, the presence of electron-phonon interaction can yield a larger thermoelectric current compared to the case without it. This intrinsic nonreciprocity opens up a new pathway for low-power electronics besides topology and superconductivity, and for nonreciprocal thermoelectric devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We study”、“We reveal”等理论分析常用表述，并基于物理机制推导出新的输运现象，未提及任何实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：电子-声子相互作用驱动的热电二极管中的非互易输运现象。具体体系为具有结构反射不对称性的器件，其中电子与声子相互作用起关键作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了电子-声子相互作用驱动的热电二极管中非互易性的内禀本质：即使不反转施加的温度差，正向和反向电子输运仍然不对称。这种内禀非互易性导致两种新现象：一种由器件中心区与电极之间温差驱动的新型热电效应，以及负载电阻中电子背散射被抑制导致的欧姆加法法则失效。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了电子-声子相互作用驱动的热电二极管中非互易性的内禀本质：即使不反转施加的温度差，正向和反向电子输运仍然不对称。这种内禀非互易性导致两种新现象：一种由器件中心区与电极之间温差驱动的新型热电效应，以及负载电阻中电子背散射被抑制导致的欧姆加法法则失效。；创新点：首次揭示了电子-声子相互作用本身即可产生内禀的非互易热电输运，无需依赖拓扑或超导等传统机制。该非互易性不依赖于温度梯度的方向反转，并导致了负载电阻中背散射抑制这一违反欧姆定律的新奇现象。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。基于电子-声子相互作用中声子发射与吸收概率的不对称性，以及结构反射不对称性，构建了热电二极管模型并推导其输运性质。

papers.title: Universal Information-Theoretic Structure of the Quasi-Stationary Domany--Kinzel Automaton
papers.abstract: We characterize the quasi-stationary distribution (QSD) of the bond directed-percolation line of the Domany--Kinzel automaton using a matrix-product-state representation of the probability distribution, obtained by projecting out the absorbing state and iterating the transfer matrix. Unlike moment- or sampling-based methods, this yields the full conditional distribution and direct access to information-theoretic diagnostics. The spatial structure of the QSD changes sharply across the transition: the active phase is bulk-like with finite density, whereas in the inactive phase the surviving activity collapses into a single flock occupying a vanishing fraction of the chain, with an internal filling that ranges from a single cluster deep in the inactive phase to a loose, partially filled group near criticality. This picture carries a sharp information-theoretic signature: throughout the inactive phase the bipartite mutual information of the QSD equals the entropy of a single binary choice -- whether the flock lies to the left or right of the cut -- so the surviving clusters together encode just one bit of positional information, corresponding to a single effective cluster. The approach extends matrix-product-state techniques to the projected eigenvector defining a QSD, opening information-theoretic diagnostics for absorbing-state systems that bulk-observable methods cannot reach.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：matrix-product-state representation、information-theoretic diagnostics、projected eigenvector。；研究对象：Domany–Kinzel 自动机中键定向渗流线的准稳态分布（QSD）及其信息论结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 准稳态分布在非活跃相中呈现为单个有效团簇，其二分互信息仅等于一个二进制选择（团簇位于分割线左侧或右侧）的熵，即仅编码1比特位置信息；而在活跃相中则为体态有限密度分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：准稳态分布在非活跃相中呈现为单个有效团簇，其二分互信息仅等于一个二进制选择（团簇位于分割线左侧或右侧）的熵，即仅编码1比特位置信息；而在活跃相中则为体态有限密度分布。；创新点：将矩阵乘积态技术扩展到定义准稳态分布的投影本征向量，从而能够对吸收态系统进行体观测量方法无法触及的信息论诊断。
papers.method_zh: 采用矩阵乘积态（MPS）表示概率分布，通过投影出吸收态并迭代转移矩阵获得准稳态分布的完整条件分布，进而直接计算信息论诊断量（如二分互信息）。

papers.title: Sonochemically Boosted Hydrogen Evolution Activity of Janus TMD Monolayers
papers.abstract: 2D electrocatalysts that enable hydrogen evolution at low overpotentials offer an attractive alternative to expensive platinum-based systems. Here, we report the growth of Janus transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) monolayers (MLs), SeMoS and SeWS, on Au foils using chemical vapor deposition, and systematically compare their catalytic properties in the context of hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) with those of their parent TMDs. The Janus MLs exhibited significantly enhanced catalytic performance relative to the parent TMDs. Furthermore, these MLs on Au foils were subjected to sonochemical treatment in polar and non-polar solvents, in which the treatment with polar solvents led to a substantial improvement in the HER activity of Janus MLs. In particular, SeMoS MLs treated with water showed a low overpotential of ~63 mV, a Tafel slope of ~42 mV/dec, and an exchange current density of ~10$^{-3}$ mA cm$^{- 2}$, approaching that of platinum. Analyses indicate that enhanced electrocatalytic activity is associated with tensile strain induced by Au surface restructuring and the formation of defects in Janus MLs, as shown by experimental observations and by density functional theory calculations. The enhancement in catalytic performance due to sonochemical treatment emphasizes the importance of our results for developing novel catalytic systems for HER based on Janus 2D materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：growth, chemical vapor deposition, experimental observations, density functional theory calculations，属于实验为主、计算为辅的混合类型）；研究对象：Janus过渡金属二硫族化物（TMD）单层（SeMoS和SeWS）在Au箔上的生长及其析氢反应（HER）催化性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Janus TMD单层相比其母体TMD表现出显著增强的HER催化活性；经极性溶剂超声处理后，其活性进一步提升，其中水处理的SeMoS单层过电位低至~63 mV，Tafel斜率~42 mV/dec，接近铂的催化性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Janus TMD单层相比其母体TMD表现出显著增强的HER催化活性；经极性溶剂超声处理后，其活性进一步提升，其中水处理的SeMoS单层过电位低至~63 mV，Tafel斜率~42 mV/dec，接近铂的催化性能。；创新点：首次将超声化学处理应用于Janus TMD单层以提升HER催化活性，并系统对比了极性/非极性溶剂处理效果，发现极性溶剂（如水）能通过诱导Au表面重构产生的拉伸应变和缺陷形成来显著增强催化性能。
papers.method_zh: 化学气相沉积（CVD）生长Janus单层；超声化学处理（sonochemical treatment）在极性和非极性溶剂中进行；电化学测试（HER活性测量）；密度泛函理论（DFT）计算辅助分析；实验观测结合理论计算揭示应变与缺陷机制。

papers.title: Modelling magnetic material properties with uncertainty-aware neural networks
papers.abstract: Machine learning is increasingly applied to accelerate the discovery of novel materials by exploring large compositional and structural design spaces. Yet, the scarcity of high-quality data and the frequent need for out-of-distribution prediction introduce substantial uncertainty, making the assessment of model reliability essential. In this work, we investigate uncertainty quantification as a means to evaluate model confidence in the context of permanent magnet research. In a first study, we benchmark classical and modern machine learning models for predicting intrinsic magnetic properties, focusing on the quality of their uncertainty estimates. We apply Gaussian negative log-likelihood loss and dropout-based Bayesian approximation as practical strategies for estimating predictive uncertainty. In a second study, we transfer these architectural features for uncertainty estimation to a more complex task: predicting coercivity from microstructural information using a graph neural network. Together, these studies demonstrate that uncertainty quantification not only enhances the trustworthiness of predictions but is also transferable across different modeling tasks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learning、modelling、predicting、graph neural network。；研究对象：永磁材料（permanent magnet）的磁学性质，具体包括本征磁性质（intrinsic magnetic properties）和由微观结构信息预测的矫顽力（coercivity）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 不确定性量化（uncertainty quantification）不仅能提升机器学习预测的可靠性，而且其方法（如高斯负对数似然损失和基于丢弃法的贝叶斯近似）可迁移至不同建模任务（从本征性质预测到微观结构-矫顽力预测）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：不确定性量化（uncertainty quantification）不仅能提升机器学习预测的可靠性，而且其方法（如高斯负对数似然损失和基于丢弃法的贝叶斯近似）可迁移至不同建模任务（从本征性质预测到微观结构-矫顽力预测）。；创新点：将不确定性量化系统性地引入永磁材料性质预测，并验证了其在不同任务（本征性质与微观结构-矫顽力）间的可迁移性。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习方法：经典与现代机器学习模型（用于本征磁性质预测）、图神经网络（用于从微观结构预测矫顽力）；不确定性估计策略：高斯负对数似然损失、基于丢弃法的贝叶斯近似。

papers.title: Ferroelectric Altermagnetic Chern Insulator in magnetic field: electrical control of the Chern number
papers.abstract: The quantum anomalous Hall effect in altermagnets is difficult to realize because spin-up and spin-down states remain degenerate at the $Γ$ point in the nonrelativistic limit. We start from the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang model to incorporate nontrivial band topology. We demonstrate that the combined effects of an external magnetic field, spin canting, and ferroelectric orbital hybridization lift the degeneracy at the $Γ$ point, enabling electric-field control of the Chern number. A minimal two-dimensional d-wave altermagnetic model with band inversion then realizes a ferroelectrically tunable Chern insulator with spontaneous spin canting. The ferroelectric polarization controls the topological phase and the orbital angular momentum, enabling a rich phase diagram with C = $\pm 1$ and C = $\pm 2$ through a Berry-curvature reorganization linked to the spin canting response and ferroelectricity. Our results establish a symmetry-consistent route to electrically tunable Chern insulating phases in altermagnetic materials, opening opportunities for low-power topological and orbitronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“We start from the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang model”“A minimal two-dimensional d-wave altermagnetic model”等理论模型构建，以及“demonstrate”“realizes”等理论推导和预言性表述，未涉及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：铁电交替磁体中的陈绝缘体相，具体为在磁场作用下通过自旋倾斜和铁电轨道杂化实现陈数电控的二维d波交替磁体模型体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在交替磁体中，通过外加磁场、自旋倾斜和铁电轨道杂化的协同作用，可以解除Γ点自旋简并，实现陈数的电场调控，并得到陈数C=±1和C=±2的可调拓扑相图。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在交替磁体中，通过外加磁场、自旋倾斜和铁电轨道杂化的协同作用，可以解除Γ点自旋简并，实现陈数的电场调控，并得到陈数C=±1和C=±2的可调拓扑相图。；创新点：提出了一种对称性一致的路径，在交替磁体材料中实现电可调的陈绝缘体相，特别是通过铁电性控制拓扑相和轨道角动量，为低功耗拓扑器件和轨道电子学器件提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 基于Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang（BHZ）模型引入非平庸能带拓扑，构建最小二维d波交替磁体模型，通过分析自旋倾斜响应、铁电极化与贝里曲率重组的关联，研究拓扑相变与轨道角动量的电控行为。

papers.title: Pinned Boundaries Delay Contraction and Shape Stress Relaxation in Active Gels
papers.abstract: Cells dynamically generate, transmit, and dissipate stress. Central to these processes is the actomyosin cortex, an active contractile material that drives cellular mechanical behavior. While prior studies have focused on freely contracting actomyosin systems, the role of mechanical constraints such as adhesion to boundaries remains less explored. To address this, we employ reconstituted actomyosin gels to investigate cellular contractility. We study contraction dynamics under pinned boundary conditions, where the gel is adhered transversely to two opposing surfaces, mimicking supracellular actomyosin networks in tissues and embryos. We find that pinned contraction leads to stress buildup, delaying contraction, producing intermittent dynamics, and generating spatially nonuniform strain fields. Stress is relieved through several pathways, including active-stress-driven symmetric constriction and defect-driven processes such as boundary detachment and internal rupture. We develop a hydrodynamic model incorporating elastic, viscous, and active stress contributions that distinguishes between stress-accumulation and stress-release phases and links variations in active stress to the observed intermittent dynamics. The model predicts distinct energy relaxation rates before and after detachment events, providing insight into stress dissipation. We compare experiments with numerical simulations, which reproduce the observed behavior and reveal how internal energy is generated and dissipated during stress buildup and relaxation. Together, our results demonstrate how boundary conditions and spatial heterogeneity govern the mechanical behavior of contractile active gels. These findings provide insight into stress regulation in cellular and tissue-scale systems and may inform the design of adaptive soft materials and bioinspired robotic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论+计算）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“employ reconstituted actomyosin gels”进行实验研究，同时“develop a hydrodynamic model”进行理论建模，并“compare experiments with numerical simulations”。；研究对象：主动凝胶（active gels），具体为重构的肌动蛋白-肌球蛋白皮层（actomyosin cortex），在钉扎边界条件（pinned boundary conditions）下的收缩动力学和应力松弛行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 钉扎边界导致应力积累，从而延迟收缩、产生间歇性动力学和空间非均匀应变场；应力通过对称收缩、边界脱离和内部破裂等多种途径释放。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：钉扎边界导致应力积累，从而延迟收缩、产生间歇性动力学和空间非均匀应变场；应力通过对称收缩、边界脱离和内部破裂等多种途径释放。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用重构的肌动蛋白凝胶（reconstituted actomyosin gels），将其横向粘附于两个相对表面以模拟钉扎边界；理论上建立包含弹性、粘性和主动应力贡献的流体动力学模型（hydrodynamic model），区分应力积累与释放阶段；数值模拟用于再现实验行为并分析内能的产生与耗散。

papers.title: On the flash temperature in accelerated sliding contacts
papers.abstract: The temperature increase in the contact regions between solids in sliding contact can easily reach several hundred Kelvin and thereby dramatically affect friction and wear. Here I extend an earlier multiscale theory for the flash temperature (Ref. \cite{MP}) to the case of accelerated motion, and present numerical results illustrating the theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“extend an earlier multiscale theory”以及“present numerical results illustrating the theory”，表明工作核心是理论扩展和数值计算，不涉及实验。；研究对象：加速滑动接触中的闪温（flash temperature）现象。具体指固体在滑动接触时，接触区域因摩擦产生的瞬时高温，该温度可高达数百开尔文，并显著影响摩擦和磨损行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，仅指出该工作将已有的闪温多尺度理论推广到了加速运动的情形，并给出了数值结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，仅指出该工作将已有的闪温多尺度理论推广到了加速运动的情形，并给出了数值结果。；创新点：将闪温理论从匀速滑动情形推广至加速滑动情形。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 多尺度理论扩展与数值计算。具体而言，作者基于一篇参考文献（Ref. \cite{MP}）中的闪温理论，将其从匀速滑动情形推广至加速运动情形，并通过数值模拟展示理论结果。

papers.title: Nonlinear Mechanics and Predictable Bifurcation of Multi-Cell Kresling Origami Chains
papers.abstract: Meta-structures that display axial-twist coupling can be achieved through the emerging kinematics in Kresling origami patterns. A central challenge in these structures is understanding their nonlinear mechanical behaviour, specifically their equilibrium branches and bifurcation diagrams. This involves identifying relationships between desired responses and the geometric variables that define the design space, including the Kresling polygon count, initial twist angle, height, radius, and crease lengths. As the number of constituent units increases in an n-layer chain, we track complex equilibrium branches extending into the post-critical regime under successive instabilities, including branch-point bifurcations and limit-point instabilities. This work begins by establishing the relationship between the geometric design variables and the response curves of the assembled chain by modelling the crease lines as axial-load-carrying elements. Subsequently, equilibrium branches and instabilities are systematically investigated via continuation and bifurcation analysis, beginning with the single-layer system and progressively extending to two- and three-layer configurations. Finally, a generalisation strategy is proposed to extend these findings to an n-layer Kresling chain. This strategy enables the predictive construction of equilibrium paths and the inverse design of multi-layer meta-structures, using prescribed critical points to control post-critical behaviour. It provides a foundation for the inverse design and optimisation of architected mechanical metamaterials with programmable responses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论文章。关键词：continuation and bifurcation analysis（延续与分岔分析）、modelling（建模）、generalization strategy（泛化策略）。；研究对象：多单元Kresling折纸链（multi-cell Kresling origami chains）的非线性力学行为，具体包括其平衡分支、分岔图以及轴向-扭转耦合效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将折痕线建模为轴向承载单元，系统研究了从单层到三层Kresling链的平衡分支与失稳模式，并提出了一种泛化策略，可预测性地构建n层链的平衡路径，并实现基于指定临界点的逆向设计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将折痕线建模为轴向承载单元，系统研究了从单层到三层Kresling链的平衡分支与失稳模式，并提出了一种泛化策略，可预测性地构建n层链的平衡路径，并实现基于指定临界点的逆向设计。；创新点：提出了一种可推广至任意层数（n层）Kresling折纸链的泛化策略，能够基于预设临界点预测性地构建平衡路径，并实现多层超结构的逆向设计与优化，为具有可编程响应的力学超材料提供了设计基础。
papers.method_zh: 采用连续与分岔分析方法（continuation and bifurcation analysis），将折痕线视为轴向承载单元进行力学建模，从单层系统逐步扩展到两层、三层乃至n层构型，系统追踪平衡分支及分支点分岔、极限点失稳等后临界行为。

papers.title: Mathematical Basis for Analyzing Superconducting Phase Transitions Using Catastrophe Theory
papers.abstract: We establish a rigorous mathematical bridge from quantum many-body path integrals to the cusp catastrophe model by Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction, which provides a theoretical foundation for analyzing superconducting phase transition using the catastrophe theory. First, it is proved that, near the critical point the infinite-dimensional effective action is diffeomorphic to a finite-dimensional catastrophe. Secondly, starting from Ginzburg-Landau free energy functional, the Euler-Lagrange partial differential equation can be reduced to the cusp catastrophe model. Thirdly, the fermionic imaginary-time path integral to the cusp catastrophe is derived through the Hubbard-Stratonovich transformation, Matsubara frequency expansion, and Grassmann algebra. Furthermore, we connect this framework with the adsorption potential theory we proposed, elucidating the catastrophic topological nature of the electron pairing mechanism in high-temperature superconductivity. The precise microscopic derivation of the adsorption potential from first-principles electronic structure calculations would strengthen the predictive power of the theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“证明”、“推导”、“约化”等理论构建词汇，核心工作是通过数学方法建立理论桥梁，不涉及具体实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：超导相变，特别是高温超导中的电子配对机制。论文旨在从数学上分析超导相变的拓扑性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Lyapunov-Schmidt约化，严格证明了在临界点附近，量子多体系统的无穷维有效作用量与有限维尖点突变模型是微分同胚的。这为利用突变理论分析超导相变提供了数学基础，并揭示了高温超导电子配对机制的突变拓扑本质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Lyapunov-Schmidt约化，严格证明了在临界点附近，量子多体系统的无穷维有效作用量与有限维尖点突变模型是微分同胚的。这为利用突变理论分析超导相变提供了数学基础，并揭示了高温超导电子配对机制的突变拓扑本质。；创新点：首次在量子多体路径积分与尖点突变模型之间建立了严格的数学桥梁，为用突变理论这一数学工具系统分析超导相变提供了理论基础。同时，将这一框架与作者提出的吸附势理论相结合，为理解高温超导的电子配对机制提供了新的拓扑视角。
papers.method_zh: 主要运用了以下理论框架和数学工具：

papers.title: Shape-space dynamics and geometric pattern formation in nonreciprocal slender bodies
papers.abstract: Nonreciprocal interactions in active solids violate action-reaction symmetry and produce a net response to strain. Assuming invariance under Euclidean symmetries, we derive a shape-space formulation for the elastohydrodynamics of nonreciprocal slender bodies that separates intrinsic deformation from rigid motion. The resulting nonlinear reaction-advection-diffusion system represents a geometric flow whose activity-driven instabilities generate steady, oscillatory, and chaotic patterns. These manifest as rigid, swimming, and chaotic motion, linking nonreciprocal elastohydrodynamics to geometric pattern formation and unifying recent observations in slender active structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“derive a shape-space formulation”、“nonlinear reaction-advection-diffusion system”、“geometric flow”。；研究对象：非互易细长体的弹性流体动力学，具体研究其形状空间动力学与几何图案形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非互易相互作用驱动的活性不稳定性可产生稳态、振荡和混沌图案，这些图案表现为刚性运动、游泳运动和混沌运动，从而将非互易弹性流体动力学与几何图案形成联系起来。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非互易相互作用驱动的活性不稳定性可产生稳态、振荡和混沌图案，这些图案表现为刚性运动、游泳运动和混沌运动，从而将非互易弹性流体动力学与几何图案形成联系起来。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于欧几里得对称性不变性假设，推导了非互易细长体的形状空间弹性流体动力学公式，将内在变形与刚性运动分离，并建立了非线性反应-平流-扩散系统作为几何流模型。

papers.title: Bulk-like Compressibility of the Au-Au Metallic Bond in the Atomically Precise $\mathrm{Au}_{25}$ Cluster
papers.abstract: We present a high-pressure single-crystal X-ray diffraction study of the atomically precise $\mathrm{Au}_{25}(\mathrm{PET})_{18}^{q}$ cluster ($q=-1,0$) up to 10 GPa under strictly hydrostatic conditions.
